jobposting.description: The AI Retrieval team powers the intelligence behind Asana's AI features by finding relevant work graph content and delivering it to LLM context windows. Our work enables AI features that truly understand your work—both within and outside of Asana—and use that understanding to take action. We also own Asana's traditional search experience.As a Staff Software Engineer on the AI Retrieval team, you'll build the systems that make Asana's AI smart and responsive. You'll tackle challenging problems in search and retrieval, working to improve the speed, cost-efficiency, and quality of our systems while expanding their capabilities to new data sources.This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.We offer a Contract of Employment (UoP) for our employees in Poland.What you'll achieveReduce the latency and cost of our retrieval system, making Asana's AI features faster and more efficientImprove the quality and relevance of search results to help users find exactly what they needExpand the retrieval system's capabilities to query new Asana objects and third-party data sourcesBuild and optimize search infrastructure using OpenSearch/ElasticSearchContribute to ML-powered features like embeddings-based retrieval and semantic searchCollaborate with cross-functional partners in New York City while building strong relationships with your Warsaw-based peersAbout you6+ years of experience writing code in a production environment Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-makingHands-on experience in search engineering, including with OpenSearch or ElasticSearchExperience with embeddings and machine learning approaches to search and retrievalExperience in an Applied AI role is a plusWe know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That's because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy - apply today.At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.What we’ll offerGenerous, transparent and fair compensation system (base salary and RSUs)Contract of Employment (and the option of 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of applicable roles ) Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med) Breakfast and lunch catering on the days that you work from the officeVacation allowanceCareer growth budget Home office setup budget Gym/Fitness cardFertility healthcare and family-forming support with CarrotMental Health Support in Modern HealthGroup life insuranceMacBooks with all necessary accessoriesFor this role, the estimated base salary range is between 40,750 - 46,333PLN gross per month (subject to all taxes and necessary deductions). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity and sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.About usAsana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

jobposting.description: Einführung & Zusammenfassung: Emagine GmbH ist eine europäische Technologie- und Managementberatung, die Unternehmen mit hochqualifizierter Expertise unterstützt. In Großinfrastrukturprojekten, u.a. in der Energie- und Netzindustrie sowie in der Bahnindustrie unterstützen wir seit 20 Jahren internationale Firmen bei der Implementierung innovativer und nachhaltiger Lösungen. Mit einem Netzwerk von über 6000 Experten in 13 Ländern bieten wir maßgeschneiderte Beratungsdienste für anspruchsvolle technische und organisatorische Projektumgebungen.Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir Sie als Teilprojektleiter Techniker Nachrichtentechnik/Elektrotechnik (w/m/d) für das Bahnnetz. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Projektrealisierung und das Management von Kommunikationsanlagen im Bahnnetz und bringen Ihre Expertise in einem dynamischen Team ein.Ihre Aufgaben:Eigenverantwortliche Koordination und Umsetzung von Projekten im Bereich Kommunikations- und Telekommunikationsanlagen.Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Terminen, Budgets und Qualitätsstandards.Steuerung und Abstimmung von Planungsbüros, Dienstleistern und Baufirmen.Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Projektleitungen sowie relevanten Stakeholdern.Koordination und Nachverfolgung aller Projektaktivitäten anhand definierter Projektpläne.Laufende Projektdokumentation und transparentes Reporting.Sicherstellung der Projektziele unter Berücksichtigung der Kunden- und Unternehmensanforderungen.Ihr Profil:Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Nachrichtentechnik, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation.Erfahrung im Bereich Telekommunikations- bzw. Kommunikationsanlagen, idealerweise im Eisenbahn- oder Infrastrukturumfeld.Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement sowie in der Steuerung technischer Projekte.Wünschenswert sind Kenntnisse der Stellwerks- oder Leit- und Sicherungstechnik.Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Schnittstellen.Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.Gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands.Zusätzliche Informationen: Diese Rolle ist in einem innovativen Umfeld angesiedelt, mit der Möglichkeit, Dienstleistungen innerhalb von Deutschland zu erbringen. Die Position erfordert ein hohes Maß an Unabhängigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein in einem dynamischen Team.Bei Interesse freuen wir uns über Ihren Lebenslauf!Für eventuelle Rückfragen stehen wir gern zur Verfügung.

jobposting.description: About the JobWe're looking for a hands-on, quality-driven QA Mobile Automation Engineer to join our Product Team in Warsaw.You'll own test automation for our family of mobile apps, working alongside QA engineers, developers, product managers, designers, and DevOps to keep them reliable as they scale. Our apps run in the field — on construction sites, on real devices, often on bad networks — so this role is as much about designing tests that survive the real world as it is about writing them.You'll design and implement automated tests, shape our mobile test architecture, integrate quality checks into CI/CD, investigate failures, and decide what testing strategy each part of the product needs.About AI ClearingAI Clearing is a technology company transforming how large-scale construction projects are monitored and managed with AI.Our platform is used on major construction sites around the world, supporting the delivery of solar farms, pipelines, transmission lines, roads, and other complex infrastructure. By combining AI, computer vision, and drone imagery, we turn field data into project intelligence, with millions of construction objects tracked to date. We build a web platform, supported by a family of mobile apps. We hold ISO 42001 (AI management) and ISO 5259-3 (AI data quality) — both world-firsts — alongside ISO 27001, 9001, and 45001.We're a global, fast-growing team with a flat structure, a strong ownership culture, and plenty of room to make a real impact.Your Profile3+ years in software testing, with at least 2 years writing and maintaining test automation yourselfStrong practical Kotlin or Java — enough to design a framework, not only extend oneHands-on experience building and maintaining Appium test suites (Appium 2.x, UiAutomator2 and/or XCUITest drivers)Comfortable with the platforms underneath: adb and logcat, emulators and simulators, app installs and permissions, reading a crash logSolid grasp of test design and test architecture — page objects, reusable fixtures, test data strategyExperience testing REST APIs, both manually (Postman or similar) and from codeA clear view of where each check belongs across unit, integration, API, and E2E — and why slow, fragile E2E suites are a trapExperience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and defining quality gatesEye for UI detail and understanding of mobile UX patterns, design systems, and component libraries (e.g., Figma).Comfortable with Git and modern development workflowsA structured, analytical approach to flaky tests: reproducing them, isolating the cause, telling a test bug from a product bugA collaborative mindset and clear communication — you can explain your reasoning to developers, QA engineers, and product peopleProfessional English — our product, documentation, and US team all run in EnglishAn appetite for learning new testing tools and modern QA practicesNice to HaveYou don't need everything on this list — it's what would help, not a checklist.Real-device or cloud device farms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, Firebase Test Lab)Native frameworks: Espresso or XCUITestCharles Proxy or Proxyman — intercepting mobile traffic, throttling, rewriting responsesTesting offline and poor-network behaviour, or other field conditionsTesting map-heavy or image-heavy UIsAgile ways of working (Scrum or Kanban)ISTQB certification (Foundation or Advanced)A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related fieldSQL, Docker, or cloud environmentsPerformance testing or observability toolsYour RoleDesign, develop, and maintain automated tests for our Android and iOS apps and the APIs behind themBuild and improve our mobile test automation architecture in Kotlin or Java with AppiumChoose the right level of testing for each product risk, and avoid over-reliance on slow, fragile E2E testsRun suites on emulators, simulators, and real devices, and keep them fast and stable in CIIntegrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and define quality gatesAnalyze results, investigate failures, and eliminate flaky testsCreate reusable test utilities, fixtures, test-data strategies, and shared componentsUse device logs, developer tools, and network proxies to investigate UI, API, and connectivity issuesWork with developers to improve testability — accessibility IDs, test hooks, debug buildsWork with developers and product managers to understand requirements and acceptance criteriaReview designs and feature specs early with Designers and PMs to spot UX/UI edge cases, off-line flow risks, and accessibility gaps before development begins.Ensure UI/UX quality and responsiveness across various mobile screen sizes, verifying implementation against Design System guidelines.Work with QA engineers to identify which tests are worth automatingEvaluate new testing tools and approaches when they can genuinely improve quality or delivery speedWhat We OfferReal impact and ownership of mobile test automation in products used on live construction projects around the worldThe chance to test complex products combining mobile and web apps, maps, geospatial data, drone imagery, APIs, and field workflowsA strong voice in our automation strategy, testing architecture, and quality engineering practicesClose collaboration with QA, engineering, DevOps, product, and design teamsA chance to improve CI/CD quality gates and development workflowsA friendly, cross-functional team that works closely togetherHybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 days remote, with flexible hoursPrivate healthcare, a MultiSport cardA B2B contract with a competitive rate

jobposting.description: Cześć!Jeśli masz minimum 5–6 h tygodniowo, które chcesz poświęcić na swój rozwój, to ta oferta jest dla Ciebie!Jesteśmy fundacją, która pomaga innym fundacjom odnaleźć się w cyfrowym świecie. 👾 Budujemy społeczność osób, które rozwijają się w IT i chcą przy tym wspierać innych. Pomagamy nie tylko NGO, ale też sobie nawzajem w odnajdywaniu ścieżek, które pomogą nam wszystkim osiągnąć swoje cele.Nasze projekty to okazja, żeby podzielić się swoją wiedzą, ale też czerpać z wiedzy innych — między innymi doświadczonych mentorów, którzy udzielają feedbacku w oparciu o Wasze przykłady. Realizujemy obecnie projekty związane z projektowaniem stron internetowych i aplikacji mobilnych, identyfikacji wizualnych, tworzeniem strategii marketingu online i automatyzacji.Jako wolontariusz/ka naszej fundacji będziesz pracować razem z zespołem nad projektami, które niosą wsparcie dla wielu organizacji non-profit. Jeśli chcesz być na bieżąco z naszymi projektami, wpadnij na naszego LinkedIna i Instagrama @cyfrowe_org ;)O projekcie „Strona od Nowa'W projekcie „Strona od Nowa' tworzymy od zera nowoczesne strony internetowe dla organizacji pozarządowych, które nie mają zasobów, aby zrobić to samodzielnie. Każdy zespół (UX, UI, Dev, Copy, PM) pracuje z jedną fundacją przez 6 miesięcy — od warsztatów i makiet, przez projekt graficzny, aż po wdrożenie strony i przekazanie jej do użytku. Działamy w pełni zdalnie, w elastycznych godzinach, rozwijając się, ucząc od siebie nawzajem i robiąc coś dobrego 💜Twoja rola jako Developer/kaJako Developer/ka w zespole będziesz:budować stronę na podstawie projektów UI i ustaleń z zespołem,wdrażać layouty, komponenty i style zgodnie z makietami z Figmy,pracować z Next.js i TypeScript,integrować treści przez Sanity CMS,współpracować z Designerami, PM-ami i resztą zespołu przez GitHuba (pull requesty, branche),dbać o jakość kodu, responsywność i wydajność strony.Kogo szukamyosób z praktyczną znajomością Next.js,z dobrą znajomością TypeScript,znających Sanity CMS,umiejących pracować z GitHubem (pull requesty, branche),komunikatywnych, otwartych na feedback i pracę zespołową.Co zyskaszprojekty dla NGO oparte o potrzeby prawdziwych organizacji, które możesz wykorzystać w portfolio,pracę w zespole (UX, UI, Dev, Copy, PM) jak w software house,feedback od mentorów i osób z doświadczeniem w branży,wsparcie społeczności i dostęp do materiałów, które tworzymy dla wolontariuszy.Sfinansowano ze środków Narodowego Instytutu Wolności – Centrum Rozwoju Społeczeństwa Obywatelskiego w ramach Rządowego Programu Wspierania Rozwoju Organizacji Poradniczych oraz Korpusu Solidarności – Rządowego Programu Wspierania i Rozwoju Wolontariatu Systematycznego na lata 2018–2030.

jobposting.description: Do spółki technologicznej należącej do międzynarodowej grupy dm poszukujemy podwykonawcy do współpracy jako:   Cloud & Data Engineer z j. niemieckim - Instore Sensorics and Data (B2B) dmTECH to ponad 1 400 ekspertek i ekspertów z różnych obszarów technologicznych, którzy każdego dnia tworzą, utrzymują i rozwijają rozwiązania retailTECH dla koncernu dm – jednej z największych europejskich sieci drogerii. Działamy w Niemczech, Austrii i Polsce. Każdego dnia efekty naszej pracy budują doświadczenia klientów, pracowników i partnerów biznesowych w 14 krajach Europy, także w naszym kraju. Kreujemy branżę reitailTECH w oparciu o najnowsze rozwiązania, współpracujemy zwinnie, myślimy długoterminowo.  Zostań naszym partnerem biznesowym wspieraj rozwój naszych rozwiązań technologicznych w Polsce.  Projekt: W obszarze Instore Sensorics and Data rozwijamy rozwiązania oparte na danych dla sklepów dm – od zbierania danych sensorycznych po skalowalne platformy chmurowe i serwisy wspierane przez AI. Pracujemy z nowoczesnymi technologiami opartymi o Google Cloud Platform, stosujemy zasady Data Mesh i coraz szerzej integrujemy rozwiązania genAI z własnymi produktami danych. Współpraca w tym obszarze łączy wiedzę techniczną z partnerską współpracą z obszarami biznesowymi, a jej celem jest przekształcanie danych w realną wartość dla działalności handlowej.  Tech Stack: GCP, Python, REST/GraphQL, Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, AI/genAI Miejsce współpracy: hybrydowo (Wrocław) lub 100% współpraca zdalna Forma współpracy: Kontrakt B2B Wynagrodzenie: Mid: 130-170 PLN/h + VAT na B2B  Senior: 170-210 PLN/h + VAT na B2B   Na czym będzie polegała nasza współpraca? Samodzielna realizacja usług w zakresie rozwoju i utrzymania usług chmurowych oraz platform danych – preferowana Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Wsparcie w budowie i rozwoju produktów danych z wykorzystaniem zasad Data Mesh, takich jak zdecentralizowana odpowiedzialność i traktowanie produktów danych jako samodzielnych usług Projektowanie i implementacja stabilnych usług backendowych oraz interfejsów REST/GraphQL do integracji różnych systemów ze środowiskiem aplikacyjnym i danymi Automatyzacja wdrożeń i infrastruktury z wykorzystaniem Infrastructure-as-Code oraz współtworzenie stabilnych, powtarzalnych pipelinów W razie potrzeby integracja usług AI/genAI, np. LLM API, z aplikacjami opartymi na danych Dbanie o wysoką jakość kodu i danych poprzez testowanie, Code Review, monitoring i Continuous Integration Współpraca z cross-funkcjonalnym zespołem projektowym i obszarami biznesowymi - przy złożonych kwestiach architektonicznych dostępne jest wsparcie doświadczonych ekspertów po stronie zespołu projektowego  Wymagane doświadczenie i kwalifikacje Kompetencje techniczne i zawodowe: Ukończone studia wyższe z informatyki, informatyki stosowanej, nauk ścisłych, technologii, inżynierii i matematyki lub porównywalne kwalifikacje techniczne Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia komercyjnego lub projektowego w Software Engineering albo Data Engineering, z udokumentowaną praktyką samodzielnego wdrażania rozwiązań Praktyczne doświadczenie z GCP (preferowane) lub AWS w zakresie tworzenia i utrzymywania rozwiązań chmurowych Doświadczenie z produktami danych i zasadami Data Mesh oraz dobre rozumienie budowy skalowalnych, wielokrotnego użytku serwisów danych Bardzo dobra znajomość Python Swobodne posługiwanie się Git, CI/CD, testingiem i Code Review Swobodna komunikacja w językach polskim oraz angielskim lub niemieckim - na poziomie minimum B2  Dodatkowymi atutami będą: Doświadczenie z Infrastructure-as-Code, np. Terraform/OpenTofu oraz technologiami strumieniowania danych, takimi jak Kafka Znajomość technologii Big Data i analitycznych oraz modelowania danych Pierwsze doświadczenia z bezpieczeństwem operacyjnych produktów danych, np. RBAC, monitoring & alerting, dependency management Doświadczenie w integracji usług AI/genAI, np. LLM API, Agentic AI Tworzenia REST/GraphQL API i usług backendowych Znajomość nowoczesnych frameworków frontendowych, takich jak React, Angular lub Vue do tworzenia dashboardów opartych na danych Znajomość bibliotek ML, takich jak TensorFlow lub PyTorch  Preferowany sposób współpracy: Samodzielny i uporządkowany sposób realizacji usług oraz wysoka inicjatywa własna Silne umiejętności współpracy zespołowej i komunikacji - cenisz współpracę cross-funkcjonalną na partnerskich zasadach Chęć uczenia się i entuzjazm wobec technologii chmurowych, danych i AI Dbałość o jakość oraz gotowość do utrzymywania wysokich standardów kodu i danych  Co Ci oferujemy?Partnerski model współpracy oparty na autonomii w realizacji powierzonych zadań, a także kulturze dialogu w naszym zespołach produktowych Elastyczność i zaufanie to dla nas podstawa: nie masz narzuconych sztywnych godzin współpracy. Działamy w oparciu o wzajemne zaufanie. Dla nas liczą się efekty Sprawny start we współpracy. Wierzymy, że dobry start współpracy musi być przygotowany. Plan wdrożenia do Twoich zadań projektowych otrzymasz z wyprzedzeniem.  Chcesz dowiedzieć się o tym, jak się u nas pracuje? Opowiedzą Ci o tym Joanna Błażejczyk, która prowadzi rekrutację i Adam Piwek z dmTECH.

jobposting.description: We are seeking a qualified Backend Software Engineer with a strong background in digital transformation initiatives to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of 5 years of experience in professional software development, particularly in distributed systems. They should demonstrate deep proficiency in Java and the Spring ecosystem, alongside an analytical mindset and a commitment to code quality. Main Responsibilities ● Modernization: Drive the transition from legacy monolithic architectures to modular, microservice-based systems.● Event-Driven Architecture: Design and implement robust streaming pipelines and messaging solutions (Apache Kafka) to handle high-volume, real-time data.● API-First Engineering: Develop and maintain high-performance RESTful APIs, adhering to OpenAPI/Swagger standards.● Cloud-Native Delivery: Manage containerized workloads on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP) using Kubernetes, focusing on CI/CD automation.● Code Quality: Uphold engineering excellence through comprehensive unit/integration testing, pair programming, and rigorous architectural design reviews.● Ownership: Take end-to-end responsibility for features from initial design to production deployment and observability. Nice to Have ● Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools.● Experience in working with agile methodologies.

jobposting.description: We're looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer who brings strong software engineering skills and a deep understanding of production systems. This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys building systems that make infrastructure more scalable, reliable, and easy to operate – using code, not runbooks.You'll work with a highly collaborative team to design and build the internal platforms that power all of Asana, from product features to AI systems to offline analytics. Our tech stack includes: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), MySQL (RDS), OpenSearch, DynamoDB, Redis, Terraform, Datadog, TypeScript, Scala, Go, and Python.We’re especially interested in people who think like backend engineers but care deeply about systems – things like failure modes, operational cost, debuggability, and performance.This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.We offer a Contract of Employment (UoP) for our employees in Poland.What you’ll achieve:Design and build frameworks, tools, and services that improve the reliability, observability, and scalability of Asana’s infrastructure.Lead end-to-end projects, from scoping and design through to rollout, across multiple systems and teams.Improve the operability of stateful infrastructure like MySQL, OpenSearch, and DynamoDB – and help drive Asana’s long-term vision for storage reliability.Debug production issues across the stack. Yes, there’s an on-call rotation – but this isn’t a pager monkey role. You’re here to fix things properly and make sure they don’t break again.Partner with product teams to shape a service-oriented architecture that enables fast, reliable development.Share knowledge through code reviews, design discussions, and mentorship.About you:Strong software engineering background – you’re comfortable writing production code and designing systems (we use Go, Python, Scala, TypeScript).7+ years of experience building and operating backend systems at scale.Familiarity with distributed systems and storage technologies (SQL, NoSQL, Search), especially in cloud environments.Experience with AWS services (e.g. RDS, EKS, IAM), Terraform, and monitoring tooling like Datadog or similar.Solid understanding of SRE principles (e.g. SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident response), but you approach reliability as a software problem first.Clear communicator and strong collaborator – you're comfortable navigating trade-offs with stakeholders across the stack.Important: If you’re only comfortable with scripting, this isn’t the right role. We’re looking for engineers who build and ship real systems.Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-makingWhy this role?Founding team: You’ll be one of the first SREs in Warsaw – and a key player in a growing team.Drive real change: This isn’t a role where you’ll just patch up legacy systems. We are expecting (and supporting) real architectural changes to improve reliability, scalability, and long-term operability.Big impact: Our product is scaling fast, and reliability is a top company priority.Room to grow: As this team grows, so will your influence – whether you want to lead projects, mentor others, or help shape how we scale.Global collaboration: Work closely with experienced engineers in San Francisco, Reykjavik, and Warsaw, while helping build the future of SRE at Asana.What we'll offer:Generous, transparent and fair compensation system (base salary and generous Restricted Stock Unit for Asana Inc.).Contract of Employment (with 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage for Engineers).Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med).Lunch catering on the days that you work from the office.Career growth budget.Home office setup budget.Gym/Fitness reimbursement.Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot.Mental health support in Modern Health.Group life insurance.MacBooks with all necessary accessories.For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 31,000 - 36,000 PLN gross monthly on the contract of employment (UoP). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base compensation range for this role may be modified.Our total compensation consists of base salary and equity (RSUs).#LI-Hybrid #LI-AZAbout usAsana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

jobposting.description: Empower financial transformation — drive innovative change in Markets & Securities Services!Krakow-based opportunity with a hybrid work model.As a Senior Business Analyst, you will be working for our client, a leading player in the financial services industry committed to delivering innovative solutions in Markets and Securities Services. jobposting.description: VOTRE FONCTION :Au sein de notre Bureau d’Études, vous intervenez sur la modélisation BIM des installations électriques dans Revit MEP, en veillant à la qualité, à la cohérence et à l’intégration des données graphiques au sein d’un environnement collaboratif.À ce titre, vos principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :- Analyser les données d’entrée nécessaires à la modélisation des installations électriques.- Modéliser les équipements électriques, armoires, chemins de câbles et réservations dans Revit MEP.- Produire des maquettes fiables et structurées, conformes aux conventions BIM du projet.- Participer à la coordination technique avec les différents intervenants du projet.- Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des méthodes de modélisation et de la qualité des maquettes numériques.- Réaliser la mise en plan de production à destination des équipes sur site, afin de faciliter l’exécution et la compréhension des installations.VOTRE PROFIL :- Vous êtes issu d’une formation technique orientée électricité, construction ou BIM, et vous disposez de bonnes bases en installations électriques.- Vous justifiez d’une première expérience en modélisation BIM et maîtrisez Revit MEP dans un contexte de production de maquettes techniques.- Rigoureux et méthodique, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et accordez une attention particulière à la qualité des livrables.

schema.description: VOTRE FONCTION :Au sein de notre Bureau d’Études, vous intervenez sur la modélisation BIM des installations électriques dans Revit MEP, en veillant à la qualité, à la cohérence et à l’intégration des données graphiques au sein d’un environnement collaboratif.À ce titre, vos principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :- Analyser les données d’entrée nécessaires à la modélisation des installations électriques.- Modéliser les équipements électriques, armoires, chemins de câbles et réservations dans Revit MEP.- Produire des maquettes fiables et structurées, conformes aux conventions BIM du projet.- Participer à la coordination technique avec les différents intervenants du projet.- Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des méthodes de modélisation et de la qualité des maquettes numériques.- Réaliser la mise en plan de production à destination des équipes sur site, afin de faciliter l’exécution et la compréhension des installations.VOTRE PROFIL :- Vous êtes issu d’une formation technique orientée électricité, construction ou BIM, et vous disposez de bonnes bases en installations électriques.- Vous justifiez d’une première expérience en modélisation BIM et maîtrisez Revit MEP dans un contexte de production de maquettes techniques.- Rigoureux et méthodique, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et accordez une attention particulière à la qualité des livrables.

jobposting.description: We're looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer who brings strong software engineering skills and a deep understanding of production systems. This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys building systems that make infrastructure more scalable, reliable, and easy to operate – using code, not runbooks.You'll work with a highly collaborative team to design and build the internal platforms that power all of Asana, from product features to AI systems to offline analytics. Our tech stack includes: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), MySQL (RDS), OpenSearch, DynamoDB, Redis, Terraform, Datadog, TypeScript, Scala, Go, and Python.We’re especially interested in people who think like backend engineers but care deeply about systems – things like failure modes, operational cost, debuggability, and performance.This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.We offer a Contract of Employment (UoP) for our employees in Poland.What you’ll achieve:Design and build frameworks, tools, and services that improve the reliability, observability, and scalability of Asana’s infrastructure.Lead end-to-end projects, from scoping and design through to rollout, across multiple systems and teams.Improve the operability of stateful infrastructure like MySQL, OpenSearch, and DynamoDB – and help drive Asana’s long-term vision for storage reliability.Debug production issues across the stack. Yes, there’s an on-call rotation – but this isn’t a pager monkey role. You’re here to fix things properly and make sure they don’t break again.Partner with product teams to shape a service-oriented architecture that enables fast, reliable development.Share knowledge through code reviews, design discussions, and mentorship.About you:Strong software engineering background – you’re comfortable writing production code and designing systems (we use Go, Python, Scala, TypeScript).7+ years of experience building and operating backend systems at scale.Familiarity with distributed systems and storage technologies (SQL, NoSQL, Search), especially in cloud environments.Experience with AWS services (e.g. RDS, EKS, IAM), Terraform, and monitoring tooling like Datadog or similar.Solid understanding of SRE principles (e.g. SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident response), but you approach reliability as a software problem first.Clear communicator and strong collaborator – you're comfortable navigating trade-offs with stakeholders across the stack.Important: If you’re only comfortable with scripting, this isn’t the right role. We’re looking for engineers who build and ship real systems.Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-makingWhy this role?Founding team: You’ll be one of the first SREs in Warsaw – and a key player in a growing team.Drive real change: This isn’t a role where you’ll just patch up legacy systems. We are expecting (and supporting) real architectural changes to improve reliability, scalability, and long-term operability.Big impact: Our product is scaling fast, and reliability is a top company priority.Room to grow: As this team grows, so will your influence – whether you want to lead projects, mentor others, or help shape how we scale.Global collaboration: Work closely with experienced engineers in San Francisco, Reykjavik, and Warsaw, while helping build the future of SRE at Asana.What we'll offer:Generous, transparent and fair compensation system (base salary and generous Restricted Stock Unit for Asana Inc.).Contract of Employment (with 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage for Engineers).Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med).Lunch catering on the days that you work from the office.Career growth budget.Home office setup budget.Gym/Fitness reimbursement.Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot.Mental health support in Modern Health.Group life insurance.MacBooks with all necessary accessories.For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 31,000 - 36,000 PLN gross monthly on the contract of employment (UoP). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base compensation range for this role may be modified.Our total compensation consists of base salary and equity (RSUs).#LI-Hybrid #LI-AZAbout usAsana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

jobposting.description: Do spółki technologicznej należącej do międzynarodowej grupy dm poszukujemy podwykonawcy do współpracy jako:   Cloud & Data Engineer z j. niemieckim - Instore Sensorics and Data (B2B) dmTECH to ponad 1 400 ekspertek i ekspertów z różnych obszarów technologicznych, którzy każdego dnia tworzą, utrzymują i rozwijają rozwiązania retailTECH dla koncernu dm – jednej z największych europejskich sieci drogerii. Działamy w Niemczech, Austrii i Polsce. Każdego dnia efekty naszej pracy budują doświadczenia klientów, pracowników i partnerów biznesowych w 14 krajach Europy, także w naszym kraju. Kreujemy branżę reitailTECH w oparciu o najnowsze rozwiązania, współpracujemy zwinnie, myślimy długoterminowo.  Zostań naszym partnerem biznesowym wspieraj rozwój naszych rozwiązań technologicznych w Polsce.  Projekt: W obszarze Instore Sensorics and Data rozwijamy rozwiązania oparte na danych dla sklepów dm – od zbierania danych sensorycznych po skalowalne platformy chmurowe i serwisy wspierane przez AI. Pracujemy z nowoczesnymi technologiami opartymi o Google Cloud Platform, stosujemy zasady Data Mesh i coraz szerzej integrujemy rozwiązania genAI z własnymi produktami danych. Współpraca w tym obszarze łączy wiedzę techniczną z partnerską współpracą z obszarami biznesowymi, a jej celem jest przekształcanie danych w realną wartość dla działalności handlowej.  Tech Stack: GCP, Python, REST/GraphQL, Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, AI/genAI Miejsce współpracy: hybrydowo (Wrocław) lub 100% współpraca zdalna Forma współpracy: Kontrakt B2B Wynagrodzenie: Mid: 130-170 PLN/h + VAT na B2B  Senior: 170-210 PLN/h + VAT na B2B   Na czym będzie polegała nasza współpraca? Samodzielna realizacja usług w zakresie rozwoju i utrzymania usług chmurowych oraz platform danych – preferowana Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Wsparcie w budowie i rozwoju produktów danych z wykorzystaniem zasad Data Mesh, takich jak zdecentralizowana odpowiedzialność i traktowanie produktów danych jako samodzielnych usług Projektowanie i implementacja stabilnych usług backendowych oraz interfejsów REST/GraphQL do integracji różnych systemów ze środowiskiem aplikacyjnym i danymi Automatyzacja wdrożeń i infrastruktury z wykorzystaniem Infrastructure-as-Code oraz współtworzenie stabilnych, powtarzalnych pipelinów W razie potrzeby integracja usług AI/genAI, np. LLM API, z aplikacjami opartymi na danych Dbanie o wysoką jakość kodu i danych poprzez testowanie, Code Review, monitoring i Continuous Integration Współpraca z cross-funkcjonalnym zespołem projektowym i obszarami biznesowymi - przy złożonych kwestiach architektonicznych dostępne jest wsparcie doświadczonych ekspertów po stronie zespołu projektowego  Wymagane doświadczenie i kwalifikacje Kompetencje techniczne i zawodowe: Ukończone studia wyższe z informatyki, informatyki stosowanej, nauk ścisłych, technologii, inżynierii i matematyki lub porównywalne kwalifikacje techniczne Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia komercyjnego lub projektowego w Software Engineering albo Data Engineering, z udokumentowaną praktyką samodzielnego wdrażania rozwiązań Praktyczne doświadczenie z GCP (preferowane) lub AWS w zakresie tworzenia i utrzymywania rozwiązań chmurowych Doświadczenie z produktami danych i zasadami Data Mesh oraz dobre rozumienie budowy skalowalnych, wielokrotnego użytku serwisów danych Bardzo dobra znajomość Python Swobodne posługiwanie się Git, CI/CD, testingiem i Code Review Swobodna komunikacja w językach polskim oraz angielskim lub niemieckim - na poziomie minimum B2  Dodatkowymi atutami będą: Doświadczenie z Infrastructure-as-Code, np. Terraform/OpenTofu oraz technologiami strumieniowania danych, takimi jak Kafka Znajomość technologii Big Data i analitycznych oraz modelowania danych Pierwsze doświadczenia z bezpieczeństwem operacyjnych produktów danych, np. RBAC, monitoring & alerting, dependency management Doświadczenie w integracji usług AI/genAI, np. LLM API, Agentic AI Tworzenia REST/GraphQL API i usług backendowych Znajomość nowoczesnych frameworków frontendowych, takich jak React, Angular lub Vue do tworzenia dashboardów opartych na danych Znajomość bibliotek ML, takich jak TensorFlow lub PyTorch  Preferowany sposób współpracy: Samodzielny i uporządkowany sposób realizacji usług oraz wysoka inicjatywa własna Silne umiejętności współpracy zespołowej i komunikacji - cenisz współpracę cross-funkcjonalną na partnerskich zasadach Chęć uczenia się i entuzjazm wobec technologii chmurowych, danych i AI Dbałość o jakość oraz gotowość do utrzymywania wysokich standardów kodu i danych  Co Ci oferujemy?Partnerski model współpracy oparty na autonomii w realizacji powierzonych zadań, a także kulturze dialogu w naszym zespołach produktowych Elastyczność i zaufanie to dla nas podstawa: nie masz narzuconych sztywnych godzin współpracy. Działamy w oparciu o wzajemne zaufanie. Dla nas liczą się efekty Sprawny start we współpracy. Wierzymy, że dobry start współpracy musi być przygotowany. Plan wdrożenia do Twoich zadań projektowych otrzymasz z wyprzedzeniem.  Chcesz dowiedzieć się o tym, jak się u nas pracuje? Opowiedzą Ci o tym Joanna Błażejczyk, która prowadzi rekrutację i Adam Piwek z dmTECH.

jobposting.description: Lokalizacja: Warszawa, ul. Marynarska 12Forma współpracy: Umowa o pracęTryb współpracy: Hybrydowy - min 50% obecności w biurzeZespół Security Governance odpowiada za zapewnienie, że organizacja działa zgodnie z wymaganiami w obszarze bezpieczeństwa – zarówno regulacyjnymi (prawo, normy ISO), jak i wewnętrznymi standardami. Jako część zespołu będziesz wspierać rozwój i utrzymanie ram bezpieczeństwa, współpracować z zespołami IT i biznesowymi oraz dbać o zgodność systemów i procesów z obowiązującymi regulacjami. Twoja rola obejmie również udział w audytach, identyfikację luk oraz rekomendowanie działań poprawiających poziom bezpieczeństwa w organizacji.Zadania, które na Ciebie czekają:Rozwój i utrzymanie ram zarządzania ryzykiem oraz systemu kontroli wewnętrznej w obszarze bezpieczeństwa informacji, cyberbezpieczeństwa i ciągłości działania.Prowadzenie oraz koordynacja procesów identyfikacji, oceny i monitorowania ryzyk dla procesów biznesowych, systemów IT oraz inicjatyw transformacyjnych.Projektowanie, ocena skuteczności i doskonalenie mechanizmów kontrolnych wspierających zgodność z wymaganiami regulacyjnymi, standardami branżowymi oraz normami ISO.Monitorowanie zmian regulacyjnych i ocena ich wpływu na organizację, w tym udział we wdrażaniu wymagań wynikających z NIS2, DORA, UKSC oraz innych regulacji sektorowych.Współpraca z właścicielami procesów i ryzyk w zakresie definiowania planów postępowania z ryzykiem oraz monitorowania działań mitygujących.Utrzymywanie i rozwój dokumentacji związanej z zarządzaniem ryzykiem, kontrolami wewnętrznymi oraz systemem zarządzania bezpieczeństwem informacji.Planowanie i realizacja audytów wewnętrznych oraz ocen zgodności z ISO 27001, ISO 22301 i wymaganiami regulacyjnymi, a także monitorowanie realizacji działań korygujących.Przygotowywanie raportów zarządczych, analiz i materiałów wspierających podejmowanie decyzji dotyczących ryzyka oraz bezpieczeństwa.Wspieranie projektów biznesowych i technologicznych poprzez ocenę ryzyka, wymagań regulacyjnych oraz adekwatności zabezpieczeń, w tym dla rozwiązań chmurowych i AI.Reprezentowanie organizacji podczas audytów, kontroli regulatorów oraz współpraca z partnerami biznesowymi, audytorami zewnętrznymi i międzynarodowymi grupami roboczymi.W realizacji zadań pomoże Ci:Wykształcenie wyższe (informatyka, cyberbezpieczeństwo, zarządzanie ryzykiem, finanse, audyt, bezpieczeństwo informacji lub kierunki pokrewne).Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w obszarze zarządzania jobposting.description: Andersen is hiring a QA Engineer for a project delivering scalable testing solutions and ensuring consistent quality and reliable releases for mobile gaming products. The customer is an international game developer and publisher focused on creating engaging mobile gaming experiences for a global audience. Its teams bring together specialists in game development, design, art, marketing, analytics, and other disciplines, supporting the full lifecycle of its products. The company has developed successful mobile titles with large international player communities and continues to expand and improve its games through new content, technology, and data-driven development. The project is focused on providing scalable QA services for a mobile game development studio to support its growing testing workload. It covers release regression testing, playtesting, map and level validation, feature acceptance, and re-testing through a flexible QA delivery model designed to ensure consistent product quality and reliable releases. Responsibilities: Building and running test sessions directly from the Unity Editor: assemble builds, execute scenarios, capture logs and performance data. Verifying object placement against design references, checking lighting/rendering correctness, memory usage per object, prop behavior, and collisions/geometry gaps at the seams between map blocks. Verifying traversability of levels/maps – identifying non-traversable areas, geometric holes, and navigation issues. Running performance testing across the agreed device matrix: Avg FPS, 1% Low FPS, Memory Peak, CPU Load, Battery Drain. Producing performance dashboards and raw profiler logs for engineering to dig into anomalies. Supporting playtest sessions and feature acceptance where engine-level or map-specific expertise is required. Re-testing performance fixes and map fixes after they are addressed by the client's development team. Feeding back into briefing packs: documenting what to look for in map/level content so the pool can be onboarded on simpler, well-scoped map tasks over time.  Requirements: Experience as a QA Engineer in GameDev for 4+ years. Hands-on experience with the Unity Editor, including comfortable navigating scenes, hierarchy, GameObjects, Transforms, Layers/Tags and Prefabs to accurately reproduce and describe bugs. Experience with level/map testing specifically: object placement QA, collision/geometry verification, lighting checks – 2D or 3D. Comfortable working from design documentation/content specs and translating them into concrete test scenarios. Level of English – from Intermediate and above.  Nice-to-haves: Experience with mobile performance profiling: FPS, memory, CPU load, battery drain, and reading raw profiler output. Reasons why this job would be interesting to you: Experience in teamwork with leaders in FinTech, Healthcare, Retail, Telecom, and others. Andersen cooperates with such businesses as Samsung, Siemens, Johnson & Johnson, BNP Paribas, Ryanair, Mercedes, TUI, Verivox, Allianz, T-Systems, etc.. The opportunity to change the project and/or develop expertise in an interesting business domain. Job conditions – you can work both fully remotely and from the office or can choose a hybrid variant. Guarantee of professional, financial, and career growth! The company has introduced systems of mentoring and adaptation for each new employee. The opportunity to earn up to an additional 1,000 EUR per month, depending on the level of expertise, which will be included in the annual bonus, by participating in the company's activities. Access to the corporate training portal, where the entire knowledge base of the company is collected and which is constantly updated. Bright corporate life (parties / pizza days / PlayStation / fruits / coffee / snacks / movies). Certification compensation (AWS, PMP, etc). Referral program. Private health insurance and sports compensation, depending on the type of employment. Your personal data is protected in accordance with GDPR regulations. Learn more: https://andersenlab.com/privacy-policy/plJoin us!

jobposting.description: Do spółki technologicznej należącej do międzynarodowej grupy dm poszukujemy partnera biznesowego do współpracy jako: IT Consultant Architecture & ALM “AI by Design” z j. niemieckim - Transportation Management (B2B) dmTECH to ponad 1 400 ekspertek i ekspertów z różnych obszarów technologicznych, którzy każdego dnia tworzą, utrzymują i rozwijają rozwiązania retailTECH dla koncernu dm – jednej z największych europejskich sieci drogerii. Działamy w Niemczech, Austrii i Polsce. Każdego dnia efekty naszej pracy budują doświadczenia klientów, pracowników i partnerów biznesowych w 14 krajach Europy, także w naszym kraju. Kreujemy branżę retailTECH w oparciu o najnowsze rozwiązania, współpracujemy zwinnie, myślimy długoterminowo. Zostań naszym partnerem biznesowym i wspieraj rozwój naszych rozwiązań technologicznych w Polsce. Projekt: Obszar produktowy Transportation Management rozwija i utrzymuje rozwiązania Supply Chain dla dm-drogerie markt. W ramach współpracy z dmTECH Polska partner biznesowy wesprze rozwój naszego produktu w modelu „AI by Design”, koncentrując się na włączaniu rozwiązań opartych o sztuczną inteligencję - od koncepcji, przez rozwój i testy, po stabilne działanie rozwiązań produkcyjnych. Istotnym elementem współpracy będzie praktyczne kształtowanie strategii AI-First, rozwijanie metod i struktur wykorzystania sztucznej inteligencji oraz automatyzacji w Application Lifecycle Management. Współpraca będzie obejmować także projektowanie stabilnej podstawy technologicznej i architektury, stanowiących fundament dalszego rozwoju innowacji w obszarze Transportation Management. Tech Stack: ALM, AI, CI/CD, SAP BTP, Cloud Foundry, SAP TM, Cloud Architecture, Enterprise Architecture Miejsce współpracy: hybrydowo (Wrocław) lub 100% współpraca zdalna Forma współpracy: Kontrakt B2B Wynagrodzenie: 160 - 210 PLN/h + VAT na B2B Na czym będzie polegała nasza współpracaWspieranie praktycznego kształtowania i rozwoju strategii AI-First, z dużą autonomią w proponowaniu rozwiązań Projektowanie i rozwijanie struktur oraz metod wykorzystania sztucznej inteligencji w całym cyklu życia aplikacji Identyfikowanie i wdrażanie usprawnień zwiększających efektywność w całym ALM oraz w inicjatywach projektowych związanych z produktem Transportation Management Wykorzystywanie sztucznej inteligencji i automatyzacji na różnych etapach realizacji usług, od koncepcji i rozwoju, przez testy i CI/CD, po stabilne działanie środowisk produkcyjnych Koordynacja merytoryczna tematów technicznych oraz inicjatyw międzynarodowych, w tym komunikacji, organizacji i uzgadniania działań projektowych Wspieranie rozwoju stabilnej bazy technologicznej i architektury jako fundamentu strategii AI-First, z wykorzystaniem podejścia Enterprise Architecture Wymagane doświadczenie i kwalifikacje Doświadczenie w budowaniu struktur i metod wykorzystania sztucznej inteligencji oraz gotowość do aktywnego wspierania rozwoju strategii AI-First Bardzo dobra znajomość Application Lifecycle Management oraz automatyzacji procesów technologicznych Wykształcenie wyższe w obszarze informatyki, informatyki biznesowej, inżynierii przemysłowej lub pokrewnym Szerokie zrozumienie technologii oraz doświadczenie w integracji złożonych środowisk systemowych Znajomość nowoczesnych architektur chmurowych, w szczególności rozwiązań takich jak SAP BTP lub Cloud Foundry Dobre rozumienie architektury rozwiązań, w tym podejścia Enterprise Architecture i Solution Architecture Doświadczenie w merytorycznej koordynacji tematów technicznych oraz wysokie kompetencje komunikacyjne i umiejętność budowania relacji z interesariuszami Samodzielność w proponowaniu rozwiązań oraz umiejętność działania z uwzględnieniem celów biznesowych i technologicznych organizacji Swobodna komunikacja w języku polskim (C1), angielskim i niemieckim (B2) Dodatkowymi atutami będąDoświadczenie w środowisku SAP, w szczególności SAP TM Gotowość do pogłębienia wiedzy w zakresie technologicznej podstawy produktu Transportation Management Co Ci oferujemyPartnerski model współpracy oparty na autonomii w realizacji powierzonych zadań, a także kulturze dialogu w naszych zespołach produktowych Elastyczność i zaufanie to dla nas podstawa: nie masz narzuconych sztywnych godzin współpracy. jobposting.description: The Data Science & Analytics team at Asana is how the company turns data into decisions — defining the questions that matter, surfacing the answers, and making sure insight is at the center of every critical product and business call. As a Senior Analytical Engineer, you sit at the intersection of Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science, and you own the data foundations for a business domain end to end. Your mandate is to turn raw data into reliable, business-ready datasets that PMs, analysts, data scientists, and leaders actually trust and use — and to define the business logic and metric standards that make AI-powered self-serve trustworthy. You consume governed Silver tables and produce the Gold layer and semantic layer beneath Asana's most important metrics, dashboards, and Genie spaces. This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, with the option to work from home on Wednesdays and, depending on the work and the teams you partner with, on Fridays. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office expectations.What you'll achieve:Own the Gold layer for a given business domain (e.g. PLG funnel, marketing attribution, revenue, NPI/AWM): Design and continuously improve the curated, dimensional data models that downstream dashboards, Genie spaces, and ELT reporting depend on.Implement the canonical business logic behind your domain's core KPIs: Translate KPIs into governed, versioned metric marts that resolve 'this number doesn't match' disputes for good.Build and curate the semantic layer and Genie spaces that power self-serve in your domain: Author the metadata, documentation, and prompt/metric definitions that let stakeholders query governed data in plain language through Claude and Databricks Genie.Own the metric dictionary for your domain: a single source of truth for what each metric means, who owns it, and where to find it. Partner with peers across DS&A to keep KPI definitions consistent where domains overlap.Author data contracts and SLAs at the Silver→Gold boundary, partnering with Horizontal Data Engineering on the inputs you depend on, and owning data quality, freshness, and oncall for Gold/metric-mart failures in your domain.Build and maintain certified, board-ready dashboards on governed Gold data, partnering with Data Science to translate insight requirements into trusted, reusable products rather than one-off builds.Partner directly with Product & Business, Data Science, and Engineering to turn ambiguous, underspecified questions into scalable datasets — anticipating downstream reporting impacts before they become incidents, and raising the data-model quality bar across the domains you touch. About you: 4+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a closely related analytics role, with a track record of independently owning the data models a team relies on for decisions.Advanced SQL and strong data modeling fundamentals: dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and semantic layer design.Hands-on experience with a transformation framework (dbt or equivalent), orchestration tooling (e.g. Airflow), version control (Git), and modern warehouse/lakehouse platforms (Databricks experience preferred).Practical experience with data quality testing and observability, schema management and data contracts, and query/model performance and cost tuning.Demonstrated domain fluency in at least one business area (e.g. PLG funnels, SLG pipeline, marketing attribution, Product telemetry, revenue/ARR) and the judgment to translate 'I don't trust this number' into a specific, durable model fix.Strong cross-functional partnership skills: requirement gathering, prioritization, documentation and enablement, driving alignment on metric definitions, and explaining technical tradeoffs to non-technical partners.Curiosity about AI-native analytics — NL2SQL, metadata/semantic layers for self-serve, and using tools like Claude and Genie to multiply your reach rather than replace rigor. Exposure to Unity Catalog, Looker/LookML, or reverse-ETL/activation (Salesforce, Marketo, Gainsight) is a plus.We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That's because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy - apply today.At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.What we’ll offerGenerous, transparent and fair compensation system (base salary and RSUs)Contract of Employment (and the option of 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of applicable roles ) Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med) Breakfast and lunch catering on the days that you work from the officeVacation allowanceCareer growth budget Home office setup budget Gym/Fitness cardFertility healthcare and family-forming support with CarrotMental Health Support in Modern HealthGroup life insuranceMacBooks with all necessary accessoriesFor this role, the estimated base salary range is between 20,833 - 23,700 PLN gross per month (subject to all taxes and necessary deductions). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity and sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.#LI-HybridAbout usAsana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

jobposting.description: Who We AreWingspan is the first payroll platform designed specifically for independent contractors and their businesses. We simplify onboarding, payments, and compliance for flexible workforces of all sizes, from solo operators to large enterprises. We're a Series B startup based in NYC with distributed teams in the USA, Poland, and the UK, and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Touring Capital, and a strong network of operators, including the CEOs and founders of Warby Parker, Harry's, Allbirds, Invision, and Flatiron Health.About the RoleAs a Software Engineer on the Payment Operations team, you will be responsible for the execution layer that ensures every dollar on Wingspan's platform is accounted for, reconciled, and moved accurately on time. You will have direct access to production systems, a mandate to identify what's broken or inefficient, and the authority to engineer the fix. This role reports to the Head of Payments & Compliance Operations and is based in Warsaw, Poland, with a remote work model.What You'll DoDesign, develop, and ship internal systems and automation that eliminate entire categories of operational toil, owning every problem end-to-end from initial diagnosis to permanent fixBuild and maintain reconciliation infrastructure that keeps Wingspan's ledger, bank records, and platform transaction data in continuous alignment, automatically and at scaleDevelop monitoring and alerting systems that surface funding health issues and payment anomalies in real time, ensuring problems are caught and resolved before they ever reach a customerCollaborate with Engineering, Product, and Finance to identify recurring operational patterns and translate them into platform-level improvements that raise the reliability ceiling for the entire systemContribute to the growth of our engineering culture by sharing knowledge, participating in code reviews, and proactively identifying opportunities to improve how the team builds, observes, and automatesQualifications & Requirements3+ years of experience in a software engineering or engineering-adjacent role with exposure to payment systems, backend services, or data pipelinesStrong SQL skills, comfortable writing standalone scripts and using AI tools such as Claude Code, Open AI, etc Familiarity with RESTful APIs and backend services, with Node.js and TypeScript experience as a plusHigh autonomy and high accountability, you thrive in fast-moving environments and default to action over escalationCompensationWe tailor compensation packages based on expertise, years of experience, certifications, and other relevant factors. Our comprehensive benefits and rewards are designed to help you thrive both professionally and personally.Perks & BenefitsUnlimited vacationCompetitive stock option package$300 one time WFH stipendTop of the line 14' MacBook ProTravel stipend for team off sitesMedicover Sports Membership

jobposting.description: We are looking for a Senior Java Engineer to help design, build and run the backend services behind our cloud communications platform — from architecture decisions through to production operations.You will work in a cross-functional engineering organisation, building distributed, cloud-native systems that power voice and messaging products used by clients across international markets.Why Apifonica?Apifonica is a communications automation platform that has been operating in the market for over ten years. AI agents, messaging, voice services and numbers operate on our own telecoms infrastructure, managed by Tenios – a company within our group and a licensed German operator that has been operating in the telecoms sector since 2001. A single contract and a single SLA cover all channels, and a single team is responsible for both the AI logic and call quality.Every month, we handle over 250 million calls and 70 million messages for more than 1,800 business clients, including MAN, ERGO, Toyota, Generali and Leroy Merlin. Our teams are based in Germany, Poland and Latvia; our head office is in Tallinn; and our infrastructure remains in Europe – it is located in Frankfurt, is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and complies with GDPR requirements.What you will doDesign & build• Design and implement backend services and APIs in modern Java (21+), Spring Boot and related frameworks• Build distributed, cloud-native applications using microservice architectures• Work with container technologies (Docker) and Kubernetes, and collaborate with Platform Engineering on infrastructure-related changes• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automationShip & operate• Own services end to end following a “you build it, you run it” mindset — including monitoring, logging, troubleshooting and incident response• Use observability tooling (metrics, centralized logging, distributed tracing, APM) to keep services healthy in production• Apply secure software development practices, including OWASP Top 10, dependency and secrets managementCollaborate & improve• Work in Agile product teams (Scrum/Kanban) with a collaborative, ownership-driven mindset• Review code, mentor colleagues, and help raise engineering quality across the team• Use AI-assisted engineering tools where useful to speed up delivery without compromising quality or securityWhat we expectMust-have• 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering with a strong focus on Java-based backend systems• Strong knowledge of modern Java (21+), Spring Boot, Spring Framework, JPA/Hibernate and RESTful API design• Experience designing and implementing distributed, cloud-native applications using microservices• Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one modern CI/CD tool (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo CD)• Fast learning curve with a track record of adapting to changing tech stacks• Solid grounding in software quality practices: automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD• Good understanding of secure development practices (OWASP Top 10, dependency & secrets management)• Experience with observability tooling: metrics, centralized logging, distributed tracing, APM• Comfortable operating production services and responding to incidents• Strong analytical thinking and sound technical decision-making in complex distributed systems• Fluent in English (written and spoken); German is a plusNice-to-have• Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) — or genuine openness to adopting them• Experience with CPaaS or cloud communications platforms, telecom protocols (SIP, RTP, WebRTC), or related open-source frameworks (FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, Asterisk)• Familiarity with carrier-grade, highly available, low-latency distributed systems• Experience with asynchronous messaging / event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ)Important to know• You will own services end to end — from design through to running them in production• Cloud-native and DevOps skills (Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability) matter as much as core Java expertise• You will work closely with Platform Engineering, Security and Product — this is a collaborative, not a siloed, role• Our domain is telecommunications and cloud communications — telecom background is a strong plus but not a requirement• We use AI-assisted engineering tools as part of our normal workflow and expect openness to themWhat we offer• Compensation: 21,000–25,000 PLN net + VAT/month (B2B), depending on experience• Hybrid working model based in the center of Warsaw• Private health insurance package (details will be provided during the recruitment process)• An international B2B technology environment: working with clients from various European markets within a rapidly growing technology company• Focus on artificial intelligence and technology: day-to-day work with cutting-edge AI solutions and digital tools• An influential team: an international, highly productive team with a fast decision-making process and a tangible impact on the company’s growth

jobposting.description: COORDINATEUR·TRICE BIM MEP EN ÉLECTRICITÉVOTRE FONCTION : Au sein de notre Bureau d’Études, vous assurez la coordination BIM des installations électriques dans le cadre de projets industriels, tout en conservant une part active de modélisation. Vous veillez à la qualité des maquettes, au respect des conventions BIM, à la bonne intégration des données techniques et à la cohérence globale des modèles dans un environnement de travail collaboratif.Responsabilités principales :- Coordonner la production et la mise à jour des maquettes BIM électriques, tout en prenant en charge une part de modélisation selon les besoins des projets.- Garantir le respect des standards, conventions et exigences BIM définis au sein du projet.- Assurer la coordination technique avec les différentes disciplines et contribuer à la résolution des clashs.- Contrôler la qualité, la cohérence et l’exploitabilité des maquettes numériques produites ainsi que des plans destinés au chantier.- Accompagner les équipes dans l’application des méthodes et outils BIM, notamment sous Revit MEP.- Participer aux échanges avec les partenaires et clients dans un contexte pouvant nécessiter une communication fluide en anglais.Votre profil :- Vous êtes issu d’une formation technique orientée électricité, construction ou BIM et disposez d’une expérience confirmée en modélisation et coordination BIM.- Vous maîtrisez Revit MEP et avez une bonne compréhension des processus de coordination multidisciplinaire ainsi que des standards BIM.- Vous êtes capable d’interagir avec des interlocuteurs techniques internes et externes en anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.- Rigoureux, structuré et orienté solution, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de projets techniques.

jobposting.description: The Product Management team drives Asana’s product strategy and execution, translating customer needs and opportunities into a compelling roadmap and working cross-functionally to deliver impactful solutions for team productivity and collaboration. We’re helping to define the Work Management category and inventing new ways for teams to work more efficiently together and see the larger purpose behind their work. Our team works directly with Engineering, Design, Experience Research, and Data Science, as well as with Sales, Support, and Marketing to ship great products. You’ll take part in every type of product work here — from strategy to product to process improvements — conceptualizing, launching, and iterating on Asana itself for millions of teams around the world. Joining our recently formed team in Warsaw, you’ll contribute to the product direction for Asana’s new product for the agentic software development lifecycle—our bet on what the next $100M+ line of business looks like. As a Staff Product Manager, you’ll work from first principles to define how modern teams plan, sequence, and ship work in an AI-native world. You’ll partner closely with design, research and engineering to turn ambiguous problem spaces into sharp, opinionated workflows that feel fast, minimal, and “obviously right” to high-performing teams. You’ll validate your bets directly with demanding customers—from hypergrowth startups to global enterprises—and be accountable for turning those insights into a focused roadmap and real business impact. This role is based in Warsaw with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.  Our employees in Poland are employed under a contract of employment. What you’ll achieveDeliver a high-craft product to a new kind of customer for Asana Build product with strong passion and operational maturityCreate a product strategy to balance multiple priorities and use cases across customers, product teams, and enterprise-level complianceNegotiate with partner teams and deliver a compelling roadmapMaximize clarity by bringing a data-driven mindset to setting concrete goals and milestones This role is for someone who wants to build a category-defining product from the ground up - not optimize an inherited roadmap. You should be comfortable saying “no” often, shipping with strong opinions, holding the quality bar at the level of the best modern SaaS tools and innovating beyond it. About you6+ years of experience in Product Management. Background in building in environments with complex data models, human-centric UX, and B2B SaaS experience preferred.Systems thinker: You feel just as comfortable modeling data relationships in a technical diagram, just as well as you can partner with Design to walk stakeholders through a holistic UX flow. Strategic: You inspire the company by creating bold, intuitive work connections within the platform and scoping them to solve the most critical customer problems.Get Stuff Done: You create, flex, and evangelize a roadmap; thoughtfully break down projects to MVPs + subsequent iterations and ship with high velocity for business impact. Customer-centric: You analyze our top customer personas; dig into the roots of customer needs; synthesize research to gain a deep understanding and narrow definition of a problem.Communication and collaboration: You partner with cross-functional teammates to deliver high-quality results. You speak with clarity and write sharp product specs. You are highly comfortable getting into deep technical discussions with engineers about the pros and cons of different approaches, and you pair with design on complex user flows.Grow Team Asana: You are a mentor for others; create great team morale among other functions and PMs; and share PM best practices you’ve cultivated to date.Growth Mindset: You lead with curiosity and are open to feedback in order to learn. At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. What we’ll offerGenerous, transparent and fair compensation systemContract of Employment (and the option of 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of applicable roles) Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med) Meals reimbursement on the days that you work from the officeCareer growth budget Home office setup budget Gym/Fitness reimbursementFertility healthcare and family-forming support with CarrotMental Health Support in Modern HealthGroup life insuranceMacBooks with all necessary accessoriesFor this role, the estimated base salary range is between 37,000 - 46,000 PLN gross per month (subject to all taxes and necessary deductions). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity and sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role. About usAsana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

jobposting.description: VOTRE FONCTION :Au sein de notre bureau d’études, vous participez à la conception de schémas électriques pour des installations neuves ou à moderniser. Selon votre expérience, vous pourrez soit développer progressivement vos compétences aux côtés de collègues expérimentés, soit prendre une place plus autonome dans la conduite technique des études.Concrètement, vous serez amené à :Analyser les besoins techniques et les données d’entrée du projet.Réaliser ou compléter les relevés sur site lorsque c’est nécessaire.Élaborer les listes I/O et contribuer au choix du matériel électrique.Concevoir les schémas de câblage et préparer les dossiers de fabrication sous EPLAN.Suivre la réalisation en atelier et, selon les projets, accompagner les interventions sur site.Participer aux essais, aux FAT et à la mise au point technique des dossiers.VOTRE PROFIL :Vous avez une formation technique en électricité (bac+2 à bac+3 minimum) et l’envie de contribuer à des projets concrets et variés.Vous utilisez EPLAN P8 ou Pro Panel, ou vous avez une bonne base qui vous permettra de monter rapidement en compétence.Vous êtes à l’aise avec les principes de distribution BT, de contrôle-commande et de conception d’armoires ou coffrets électriques.Une première expérience est un plus, mais nous restons également attentifs aux profils juniors motivés comme aux profils plus expérimentés souhaitant relever un nouveau défi.Vous aimez le travail bien fait, l’esprit d’équipe et les environnements où la technique rime avec engagement et progression.

jobposting.description: Hey! Nice to see you! At Incubly, we believe that great people want to work with great people, so we started building a company that would attract great minds and allow us to achieve everything without feeling like we're just working, but rather having fun. Our mission is to mainly support tech companies and startups (scaleups) in fast, high-quality scaling up of their teams and boosting their product development, testing, and deployment so that we can succeed together.We are currently partnering with our client to expand their SEP4G Core development team and are looking for a highly skilled QA Engineer (Android / iOS App Test). In this role, you will collaborate with experienced architects, business analysts, and senior developers to deliver secure, highly available digital identity solutions based on applied cryptography and modern identity technologies. Your daily responsibilities:  Participate in the analysis of business requirements and contribute to the design of new features.Take ownership of the end-to-end testing process, from identifying test objectives and designing test cases to organizing test suites and monitoring test execution.Maintain, enhance, and expand test coverage to ensure the quality and reliability of the application.Perform manual testing across multiple operating systems, browsers, and mobile devices.Analyze test results, investigate defects, and contribute to risk assessments related to identified issues.Stay up to date with the latest mobile devices, operating systems, and market trends to ensure testing covers the most relevant platforms and configurations. We need you to have: A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or another relevant technical field.At least 5 years of hands-on experience in software testing, with a solid understanding of test processes and test design techniques.ISTQB Foundation certification (or equivalent knowledge).Practical experience testing applications on Android and iOS devices, as well as across different web browsers.Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.Familiarity with complex software development workflows, including branching strategies and version control systems.Experience using Jira and test management tools.Experience with test automation is a plus, particularly in Cucumber (functional testing) and ReadyAPI (REST/API testing).Fluency in English (both verbal & written) Our Architecture and Technology Stack: Methodologies: Agile, ScrumTest Management: Jira, Test Management ToolsAutomation: Cucumber, ReadyAPIPlatforms: Android, iOS, WebVersion Control: Git Our offer: In addition to a great company and challenging projects, we can offer much more, i.e. Hybrid work model – working from the client's office located at Jaracza Street, Łódź, three days per week, with the remaining days available for remote work.Monthly remuneration offered: 11.000 - 13.500 zł gross/ month on the Employment Agreement or 700- 850 zł net/day on a B2B Contract
