jobposting.description: Einführung und Zusammenfassung:Wir suchen einen engagierten Fachtester für Wechselprozesse und Stammdatenänderungen. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat bringt umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Energieversorgung und im Umgang mit SAP IS-U mit. Zu den Schlüsselqualifikationen gehören ein hohes Maß an Detailgenauigkeit, analytische Fähigkeiten und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise.Rolle: Fachtester für Wechselprozesse + StammdatenänderungStart: 01.11.2026Laufzeit: 18 MonateOrt: München / Remote - nach AbspracheRemote: möglich Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:Der Fachtester wird das agile Team in der Testausführung und in fachlichen Fragen unterstützen.Die Kernverantwortlichkeiten umfassen:Identifikation von Testfällen auf Grundlage von Anforderungen/Userstories.Durchführung von Testfällen im SAP IS-U mit Schwerpunkt auf Wechselprozesse und Stammdatenänderungen.Planung, Erstellung und Durchführung manueller Tests.Abdeckung der End-to-End-Tests (Integrationstests und Regressionstests).Mitwirken in Refinements und Sprint-Reviews, um qualitatives Feedback zu geben.Fehlermanagement: Analyse und Dokumentation von Abweichungen sowie Nachverfolgung der Fehlerbehebung.Erstellung und Dokumentation von Testkonzepten und Testhandbüchern. Schlüsselanforderungen:Die folgenden Qualifikationen sind für diese Position zwingend erforderlich:Sicherer Umgang mit SAP IS-U.Umfassende Erfahrung in der Energieversorgung und in den folgenden Prozessen:Wechselprozesse (GPKE / GeLi Gas / WiM).Stammdatenänderungen.Integration und Kommunikation im Datenaustausch mit Netzbetreibern und Messstellenbetreibern.Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Testbereich, idealerweise im Energie-/Versorgungsumfeld.ISTQB-Zertifizierung (Foundation Level oder höher) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.Erfahrung in Jira / XRay.Nice to Have:Zusätzliche Fähigkeiten, die von Vorteil sind:Fließende Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit.Hohe Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.Ich freue mich auf Ihre Kontaktaufnahme!

Marynarska 12Forma współpraca: Direct B2BTryb współpracy: Hybrydowy - wymiar do ustaleniaRekrutacja onlineDołącz do programu transformacji danych w T‑Mobile i współtwórz program, który zmienia sposób, w jaki pracujemy z danymi na co dzień. Pracuj z najnowocześniejszymi technologiami, miej realny wpływ na strategię danych i rozwijaj kompetencje przyszłości w kulturze otwartej na innowacje. Stwórz z nami przestrzeń na eksperymentowanie, szybkie prototypowanie i tworzenie rozwiązań, które kształtują przyszłość telekomunikacji napędzaną danymi.Dołącz do nowego, strategicznego projektu transformacji danych: przenosimy analitykę z onpremise do GCP, budując od zera architekturę i model danych z mocnym naciskiem na zwiększanie wartości biznesowej i CX naszych klientów.Pracujemy na technologiach: GCP, Spark, Python, Kubernetes, BigQuery, Vertex AI, Terraform, Looker, Oracle. Integrujemy różnorodne, wysokowolumenowe źródła danych, projektujemy warstwy przetwarzania w trybach streaming i batch, wdrażamy data governance, lineage, jakość i bezpieczeństwo danych, a także CI/CD i monitoring/SLO, aby skrócić drogę od pytania do odpowiedzi dla naszego biznesu i zbudować solidny fundament pod rozwiązania AI/LLM. Szukamy osób, które łączą architekturę z praktyką inżynierską i rozumieniem potrzeb biznesowych, wnoszą proaktywność, energię i świeże pomysły, i chcą realnie współkształtować standardy, wzorce oraz kierunek rozwoju naszej platformy danych.Zadania, które na Ciebie czekają:Definiowanie architektury i standardów data contractów w firmieProjektowanie i wdrażanie data contractów (formaty, schematy, walidacja, proces wersjonowania)Implementację automatycznych walidacji schematów i jakości danychDobór narzędzi wspierających automatyzację kontraktów Ustanowienie procesów tworzenia, utrzymywania i ewaluacji kontraktów danychWspółpracę z zespołami produktowymi, data engineeringiem, BI i właścicielami danych, wspieranie zespołów developerskich przy definiowaniu kontraktów W realizacji zadań pomoże Ci:Minimum 4–5 lat praktycznego doświadczenia w Data Engineering, Data Governance, Data Quality, analizie danych lub pokrewnych obszarach, w tym doświadczenie w samodzielnym projektowaniu i wdrażaniu rozwiązań przekrojowych.Praktyczna znajomość zagadnień dotyczących obszaru Data Contracts (definiowane data contracts, wymagań jakościowych) i narzędzi wspierających automatyzację kontraktów (np. OpenAPI/JSON Schema, narzędzia do CI/CD, QA danych)Doświadczenie w analizie, przetwarzaniu i modelowaniu danych, znajomość architektury rozwiązań Hurtowni Danych i Big DataZnajomość tworzenia zapytań SQL na poziomie zaawansowanym poparta praktycznym doświadczeniem zawodowym  Doświadczenie w projektowaniu modeli danych i budowie warstw danych  Praktyka w zapewnieniu jakości danych (testowanie, monitorowanie, alertowanie)Doświadczenie w dokumentacji technicznej oraz code reviewDoświadczenie w samodzielnym prowadzeniu tematów wymagających współpracy wielu zespołów — identyfikowaniu zależności, ustalaniu odpowiedzialności, zarządzaniu blockerami i doprowadzaniu do decyzji.Umiejętność działania w sytuacji niepełnych wymagań i braku jednoznacznego rozwiązania — od zdefiniowania problemu do wdrożenia rozwiązania.Umiejętność pracy zespołowej i komunikacji z zespołami biznesowymi, technicznymi oraz analitycznymi.Proaktywność, odpowiedzialność i nastawienie na jakość w obszarze danych.  Mile widziane:Znajomość standardu ODCS Znajomość ekosystemu GCPDoświadczenie z narzędziami zarządzania danymi, np.:       - dbt, Dataform (transformacja i dokumentacja danych)       - Knowledge Catalog (dawniej Dataplex), Data Catalog (zarządzanie ładem danych)Znajomość zagadnień z obszaru Data Governance i Data QualityOferujemy:🚲Benefity🚲Opieka medyczna, pakiety sportowe, parking przy biurze na Marynarskiej czy specjalna oferta abonamentowa to dla nas podstawa. Na naszej platformie benefitowej znajdziesz ofertę, z którą zadbasz o ciało, duszę i umysł, ale najważniejsze jest to, że to Ty wybierasz z czego korzystasz!🎂Świętowanie🎂Dostaniesz od nas dodatkowy dzień urlopu z okazji swoich urodzin lub imienin.💰Program poleceń💰W ramach Programu Poleceń Znam Talent możesz zaprosić znajomych do pracy w T-Mobile i jeszcze na tym zarobić.🎁Odpowiedzialność🎁Lubimy pomagać i angażujemy się w wiele inicjatyw społecznych. jobposting.description: The Data Science team helps us fulfill our mission by informing strategy, defining success metrics, and identifying new ways to deliver user value. Data scientists are at the crux of deepening our understanding of the customers and driving more business outcomes by leveraging experimentation, causal inference, statistical and machine learning techniques, and data storytelling. We understand our company’s goals and proactively inform their direction with data so that our product can help more teams do great things.As a Data Scientist at Asana, you’ll help us ask the right questions and answer them rigorously. You’ll work closely with our Product and Business teams to understand their goals and proactively inform their direction with data. You’ll keep taking on new responsibilities as you grow—from defining core metrics to building machine learning models and keeping the data flowing in our pipelinesThis role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.We offer a Contract of Employment (UoP) for our employees in Poland.What you’ll achieveDesign and analyze experiments to measure the impact of new product features.Investigate high-level questions like “What are the collaborative patterns of the most successful teams using Asana?”Add new metrics and aggregations to our data warehouse to make new classes of questions answerable.Build models to predict the growth trajectory of different customer segments.Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, product management, and business teams to drive data-informed decision-making.About youBachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Engineering, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.3+ years of experience in applying data science techniques to drive technical product development and decision-making.Strong technical background in statistics, mathematics, information science, or another heavily quantitative field.Fluency in at least one modern language useful for data processing (such as Python or Scala).Proficiency with relational data modeling and SQL.Expertise in statistical methods and experimental design and analysis.Experience with measurement techniques for search ranking, relevance, or quality assessments.Experience with distributed data processing systems (such as Spark or Redshift).Background in advanced statistical modeling (e.g., GLM, mixed effects) and/or machine learning techniquesDemonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.What we’ll offerFor this role, the estimated base salary range is between 29,000 PLN - 32,900 PLN (gross monthly). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:Generous, transparent and fair compensation systemContract of Employment (and the option of  50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of  applicable roles ) Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med) Meals reimbursement on the days that you work from the officeCareer growth budget Home office setup budget Gym/Fitness reimbursementFertility healthcare and family-forming support with CarrotMental Health Support in Modern HealthGroup life insuranceMacBooks with all necessary accessories#LI-Hybrid #warsawAbout usAsana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

jobposting.description: Asana’s rapid growth brings new challenges in keeping our systems fast, reliable, and resilient. As our product evolves, we’re making a major investment in reliability – and building a brand new SRE team in Warsaw is a key part of that strategy. This is your chance to help shape it from day one.This isn’t a traditional “ops” role – we’re looking for strong software engineers who are passionate about building reliable, distributed systems. You’ll work closely with a small SRE team in San Francisco, infrastructure engineers in Reykjavik, and an established infrastructure team in Warsaw. Warsaw will be a significant hub for our future infrastructure engineering and operations. As one of the first engineers here, you’ll have a real say in how we build reliable infrastructure, manage incidents, and support the rest of the company.This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.We offer a Contract of Employment (UoP) for our employees in Poland.What you’ll achieveInfluence the future of Asana’s SRE practice, especially as we grow the Warsaw team.Lead reliability-focused projects across our stack – from infrastructure to tooling to incident response.Define and implement Asana’s incident management process – we’re investing here, and you’ll help shape how it works.Build internal platforms and frameworks that help other teams improve the reliability of their services.Be part of (and help shape) a sustainable on-call rotation – shared across teams in Warsaw, San Francisco, and Reykjavik. On average, we handle ~1 page per day, but it’s not constant, and we care about keeping things sane.Work with our stack: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Datadog, MySQL (RDS), ElasticSearch (OpenSearch), Redis, DynamoDB, Terraform, TypeScript, Scala, Go, and Python. (Yeah, we know this sounds like buzzword bingo – but we want this post to actually show up in your searches.)About youYou’re a strong and experienced software engineer who’s comfortable writing and reading code – this isn’t an ops role.You care about reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability, not just quick fixes.You might have worked as an SRE before – or maybe you were a product engineer who kept getting pulled into infra work because you cared about how systems actually run.You’ve seen systems at scale (or want to), and you’re excited about solving infrastructure problems that have broad impact.You’re curious, take initiative, and aren’t afraid to work in ambiguous spaces – especially important on a brand new team.You collaborate well across teams and want to help others build more reliable systems.You don’t need to know our exact stack, but you’re eager to learn whatever it takes to make things better.You demonstrate curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.Why this role?Founding team: You’ll be one of the first SREs in Warsaw – and a key player in a growing team.Drive real change: This isn’t a role where you’ll just patch up legacy systems. We are expecting (and supporting) real architectural changes to improve reliability, scalability, and long-term operability.Big impact: Our product is scaling fast, and reliability is a top company priority.Room to grow: As this team grows, so will your influence – whether you want to lead projects, mentor others, or help shape how we scale.Global collaboration: Work closely with experienced engineers in San Francisco, Reykjavik, and Warsaw, while helping build the future of SRE at Asana.What we'll offerGenerous, transparent and fair compensation system (base salary and generous Restricted Stock Unit for Asana Inc.).Contract of Employment (with 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage for Engineers).Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med).Lunch catering on the days that you work from the office.Career growth budget.Home office setup budget.Gym/Fitness reimbursement.Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot.Mental health support in Modern Health.Group life insurance.MacBooks with all necessary accessories.For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 31,000 - 36,000 PLN gross monthly on the contract of employment (UoP). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base compensation range for this role may be modified.Our total compensation consists of base salary and equity (RSUs).#LI-Hybrid #LI-AZAbout usAsana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

jobposting.description: We are looking for an experienced Test Automation Engineer / Automation Quality Engineer to improve and modernise an existing test automation landscape. The role is focused on reducing test execution time, increasing release confidence, improving GUI regression coverage, and supporting the migration of test pipelines to GitHub Actions.This is a hands-on role for someone who understands test automation at scale, can work close to backend/platform teams, and is comfortable using AI tools to identify gaps, troubleshoot issues, and speed up engineering work.Key responsibilitiesRefactor and improve the existing load testing suite, with the goal of reducing test execution time from around 16 hours to under 4 hours.Improve test performance and reliability to support faster deployments and shorter time to market.Migrate remaining test suites from Jenkins to GitHub Actions.Improve release confidence by making automated test execution more reliable and maintainable.Enhance the GUI regression test suite to reduce change failure rate.Analyse test failures, identify gaps in coverage, and propose improvements to the automation strategy.Work with engineering teams to improve testability, stability, and feedback loops.Use AI tools to support test analysis, gap detection, troubleshooting, and automation improvements.Must-have skillsStrong experience with Selenium.Strong experience with Java and/or Groovy.Experience in automation quality engineering or backend-oriented test automation.Practical experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as:Serenity BDDCucumberJUnitAllureExperience with GitHub Actions or strong willingness to work with it.Basic understanding of Kubernetes.Strong willingness and ability to use AI tools in daily work, especially for identifying issues, gaps, and improvement areas.Nice to haveExperience migrating pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions.Experience with load testing or performance-focused test suites.Experience with Java WebSocket testing.Backend engineering background or ability to troubleshoot close to application code.Experience improving large, slow, or unstable test suites.

schema.description: Unleash innovation in financial technology — drive digital transformation with tomorrow’s Java platforms today!Krakow-based opportunity with hybrid work modelAs a Senior Java Microservices Developer – Cloud & DevOps Leadership, you will be working for our client, a leading entity within global banking and market services. Apply now and include your CV (preferably in English) along with a statement confirming your consent to the processing and storage of your personal data.

jobposting.description: The Product Management team drives Asana’s product strategy and execution, translating customer needs and opportunities into a compelling roadmap and working cross-functionally to deliver impactful solutions for team productivity and collaboration. We’re helping to define the Work Management category and inventing new ways for teams to work more efficiently together and see the larger purpose behind their work. Our team works directly with Engineering, Design, Experience Research, and Data Science, as well as with Sales, Support, and Marketing to ship great products. You’ll take part in every type of product work here — from strategy to product to process improvements — conceptualizing, launching, and iterating on Asana itself for millions of teams around the world.We are looking for an experienced product manager to join the team responsible for key elements of Asana’s work platform strategy. Over the next 2 years, a critical piece of Asana’s strategy is to continue building out a platform that can support many different types of workflows. You’ll be responsible for understanding how customers’ need to structure work to enable their workflows and build out the features to meet those needs directly, and enable other Asana R&D teams to incorporate structure into their features. You’ll work with a large set of cross-functional partners across both our GTM and internal teams to learn about how internal and external customers of all sizes need to customize their core Asana experience to support their workflows, and how your work fits within the entire customer lifecycle so that we customers feel confident in structuring their work in the right way at the right time to power.This role is perfect for a product manager with deep customer empathy for the complexity of mapping messy work to a structured tool, has an end-to-end ownership mindset, and drives for results. We are looking for someone who has experience building software in partnership with enterprise customers, strong product intuition, and can marry qualitative insights with quantitative data to deeply understand the customer experience. You thrive on learning from customers, and are excited to partner with engineering, design, user research, sales, and the rest of our amazing PM team.This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.What you’ll achieveDefine and deliver a compelling roadmap to ensure customers have the structure they need to power their end to end workflows.Synthesize input from customers, user research, data science, and business partners, ensuring we are continuously investing in the right ways to structure work, and shifting quickly when an area is no longer leveraged.Take new initiatives from 0 to 1, and then scale them up, as we validate product market fitPartner closely with design, engineering, marketing, and customer success to co-create a cohesive end to end journey and execute on the roadmap with velocity.Collaborate across the R&D organization to support other R&D teams in achieving their goals.About you5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with at least 1-2 years experience on B2B SaaS.Customer-centric: You spend time directly with customers to understand their nuanced challenges and synthesizing research to identify and solve problems..Communication and collaboration: Demonstrate strong communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams, clarifying complex concepts and writing precise product specifications. You pair effectively with design, engineering, and our business teams.Systems thinker: Think systemically, creating solutions that simplify complex use cases for customers.Strategic: Provide strategic insights and create intuitive connections within the custom field & types features and platform to address critical customer issues.Get Stuff Done: Execute projects with high velocity, breaking them down into MVPs and iterative stages for impactful delivery.Grow Team Asana: Foster team morale and share best practices in product management.Growth Mindset: Embrace a growth mindset, welcoming feedback and maintaining curiosity in learning.At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.What we’ll offerOur comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 29,000 - 31,935PLN. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:Mental health, wellness & fitness benefitsCareer coaching & supportInclusive family building benefitsLong-term savings or retirement plansIn-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.#LI-HybridAbout usAsana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

jobposting.description: Our Security team keeps Asana's employees, users, and customers safe, by proactively addressing threats and fostering a culture of security throughout our product and operations. We are looking for a savvy Security Engineer to join our Blue Team in Warsaw. You will be a foundational member of the security presence in our Warsaw innovation hub, partnering directly with IT, infrastructure, and product teams to ensure we have robust detection and response capabilities. Detection and response here leans on engineering practice. We are investing in automation and detection-as-code to cut down on manual triage, and we are looking for someone comfortable writing and reviewing code as part of that work.This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.We offer a Contract of Employment (UoP) for our employees in Poland.What you'll achieve:Lead detection, analysis, and response across our cloud and SaaS environments, identity providers, endpoints, and the software supply chain, ensuring timely and effective remediation of security incidents.Investigate and remediate security incidents across cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), identity providers (e.g., Okta), and SaaS environments.Investigate and contain software supply chain and CI/CD incidents, from unauthorized changes in build environments to suspect third-party dependencies (e.g., npm, PyPI).Help build and maintain our detection-as-code infrastructure (e.g., Panther), SOAR automation, and response playbooks, treating detection logic as tested, version-controlled production code.Utilize and optimize security tools such as Panther for SIEM, CrowdStrike for endpoint detection and response, and other security platforms.Conduct proactive threat hunting and operationalize threat intelligence across cloud, endpoint, and identity telemetry to catch threats beyond standard SIEM alerting.Conduct forensic analysis during security incidents to understand the scope and impact of incidents.Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into development processes and provide guidance on secure configurations.Develop and deliver training to educate engineers on security operations and incident response best practices.About you:7+ years of experience in threat detection, security operations, or incident response, including investigating incidents across cloud platforms, identity providers, and SaaS applications, with practical knowledge of audit logging and IAM.Proficient in Python (Bash, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript is a plus) for security scripting and automation, with hands-on experience across REST APIs, Git workflows, and PR-based code reviews.Hands-on experience investigating software supply chain threats, with fluency in auditing modern developer ecosystems (e.g., npm, PyPI), build logs, and CI/CD pipelines.Familiarity with 'Detection as Code' methodologies, including test-driven detection logic and rule management through CI/CD pipelines.Strong experience with SIEM platforms (e.g., Panther, Splunk, Elastic Security) for log analysis, alert correlation, and dashboard creation.Deep working knowledge of endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools (e.g., CrowdStrike, SentinelOne) and their capabilities.Experience performing digital forensics and root-cause analysis to determine incident scope and impact.Familiarity with common attack techniques, tactics, and procedures (TTPs) and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.Collaborative and pragmatic, with strong communication skills across technical and non-technical partners, committed to building robust defenses and helping engineers do their best, most secure work.Demonstrated curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.What we offer:Generous, transparent and fair compensation system (base salary and RSUs).Contract of Employment (and the option of 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of applicable roles).Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med).Breakfast and lunch catering on the days that you work from the office.Vacation allowance.Career growth budget.Home office setup budget.Gym/Fitness card.Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot.Mental Health Support in Modern Health.Group life insurance.MacBooks with all necessary accessoriesFor this role, the estimated base salary range is between 31,900 - 36,250 PLN gross per month (subject to all taxes and necessary deductions). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified. In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity and sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefitsfor this role.

jobposting.description: About the JobWe are looking for an analytical, well-organized, and outcome-driven Product Manager to join our Product Team in Warsaw. The work sits at the intersection of product and UI/UX design.You will work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, QA engineers, and business stakeholders, turning customer needs and business problems into clear product requirements, well-scoped epics, and measurable outcomes. Your work spans the full product development process.This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own product areas on complex products combining web and mobile apps, maps, geospatial data, drone imagery, analytics, and construction workflows. You will own selected modules end to end and lead initiatives from problem discovery through delivery and adoption, with plenty of room to develop your product and design skillset alongside our Design Team.About AI ClearingAI Clearing is a technology company transforming how large-scale construction projects are monitored and managed with AI.Our platform is used on major construction sites around the world, supporting the delivery of solar farms, pipelines, transmission lines, roads, and other complex infrastructure. By combining AI, computer vision, and drone imagery, we turn field data into project intelligence, with millions of construction objects tracked to date. We build a web platform, supported by a family of mobile apps. We hold ISO 42001 (AI management) and ISO 5259-3 (AI data quality) — both world-firsts — alongside ISO 27001, 9001, and 45001.We are a global, fast-growing team with a flat structure, a strong ownership culture, and plenty of room to make a real impact.Your ProfileAt least 2 years of professional experience in product management, product ownership, or business analysis for a software productA track record of shipping features end to endA strong analytical mindset, able to structure complex information and make trade-offs explicitA solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and how web and mobile products are designed and builtAble to translate business needs into clear epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and business rulesExperience working with product data — defining success metrics, reading dashboards, and using analytics to evaluate decisionsThe confidence to ask questions early, resolve ambiguity, and drive decisions to closureA collaborative mindset and clear communication — comfortable with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including customersGood understanding of UI/UX fundamentals, screen layouts, and user journeys on web and mobileHands-on Figma skills — comfortable drafting initial wireframes, user flows, and low-fidelity prototypes to visualize concepts earlyAn eye for UI consistency, visual hierarchy, and design systemsProfessional English — our product, documentation, and US team all run in EnglishPractical experience with tools such as Jira, Notion, Figma, Miro, and a product-analytics tool like PostHog, Amplitude, or MixpanelNice to HaveYou don't need everything on this list — it's what would help, not a checklist.Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with enterprise or field-heavy usersExperience running product discoveryExperience with process modeling, API concepts, or data modelsComfort working with data — SQL or product analytics beyond dashboardsFamiliarity with construction technology, GIS, or geospatial productsExperience designing mobile and field workflows, including offline scenariosAcademic or practical background in UX/UI design, interaction design, or conducting usability researchAgile ways of working (Scrum or Kanban), in a Product Owner or equivalent roleYour RoleOwn selected product areas: understand customer needs, business problems, and product opportunities, and shape them into a clear directionRun product discovery — interviews, workshops, research, and analysis — with customers, field teams, and internal stakeholdersDefine the problem, the target outcome, and the success metric before defining the solutionTurn opportunities into clear requirements: epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, business rules, and dependenciesDraft early user flows, structural wireframes, and concept sketches using tools such as Figma to give the Design Team a solid foundation on complex featuresPartner closely with our Designers on UX research, usability edge cases, and feature refinements while respecting our Design SystemPrioritize and refine the backlog, get requirements ready for development, and stay close to stakeholder updates clear and currentSupport sales, customer success, and onboarding with product knowledge and customer-facing materialsWhat We OfferReal ownership of product areas used on live construction projects around the worldThe chance to shape complex products combining AI, web and mobile apps, maps, geospatial data, drone imagery, analytics, and mobile field workflowsA strong voice in product direction, prioritization, and how we run discovery and deliveryClose collaboration with experienced product managers, designers, engineers, and QA engineersExposure to the full product lifecycle — from discovery and requirements analysis to implementation, release, and measured impactMentorship and room to grow your UX/UI skillset alongside our Design TeamDirect contact with customers and field teams in the US and EuropeA friendly, cross-functional team that works closely togetherHybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 days remote, with flexible hoursPrivate healthcare, a MultiSport cardA B2B contract with a competitive rate

jobposting.description: About the RoleAs a Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Asana, you will leverage your strong software engineering skills and deep understanding of production systems to build scalable, reliable, and easy-to-operate infrastructure using code.Work on designing and building internal platforms powering product features, AI systems, and analytics using AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), MySQL (RDS), OpenSearch, DynamoDB, Redis, Terraform, Datadog, and several programming languages.ResponsibilitiesDesign and build frameworks, tools, and services improving infrastructure reliability, observability, and scalability.Lead end-to-end projects across multiple systems and teams from scoping to rollout.Enhance operability of stateful infrastructures such as MySQL, OpenSearch, and DynamoDB.Debug production issues effectively; participate in on-call rotation with focus on durable fixes.Collaborate with product teams to develop a reliable service-oriented architecture.Share expertise through code reviews, design discussions, and mentoring.Requirements5+ years in software engineering focused on building and operating backend systems at scale.Proficient in Go, Python, Scala, and TypeScript including production code development and system design.Strong knowledge of distributed systems and storage tech (SQL, NoSQL), especially in cloud (AWS).Experience with AWS services (RDS, EKS, IAM), Terraform, and monitoring tools (Datadog or similar).Good understanding of SRE principles focusing on reliability as a software problem.Clear communication and collaborative skills for cross-stack stakeholder engagement.Strong software engineering skills beyond scripting.Workplace & ContractThis position is based in Warsaw with a hybrid office schedule (on-site Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). Employment contract (UoP) is offered in Poland.Compensation & BenefitsGross base salary between 23,000 and 33,000 PLN per month (UoP contract).Generous Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of total compensation.Comprehensive health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med).Lunch catering on office days.Career growth budget, home office setup, and gym reimbursement.Family support programs and mental health assistance.Company-provided MacBooks and accessories.About AsanaAsana is a leading platform that helps teams achieve goals faster worldwide. Awarded Top 10 Best Workplace for 5 years and Fortune's #1 Best Workplace in the Bay Area, Asana fosters a culture of inclusion, equity, and belonging.We are committed to equal employment opportunity and pay equity through careful assessment and annual audits. Join us to make a real impact and grow your career globally.

jobposting.description: About usAt Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.Our valuesWin as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.  About the roleAs DBE, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's relational database systems. This role will ensure the integrity, availability, and performance of critical data to support business operations and decision-making processes. The DBE will work closely with IT teams, developers, and business stakeholders to deliver efficient and scalable database solutions that meet the organization's current and future needs. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills in Postgres and SQL Server database management systems hosted in AWS, excellent problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to translate business requirements into effective relational database solutions. This role will be critical in maintaining the organization's data infrastructure, enabling data-driven decision-making, and ensuring the optimal performance of mission-critical applications across the enterprise.What will you be doing?Develop database schemas, tables, and indexes to optimize performance and ensure data integrity.Implement and maintain database security measures, including user authentication, access controls, and data encryption.Analyze and interpret database performance metrics to proactively identify areas for improvementMonitor database performance and troubleshoot issues such as slow queries, database locks, and resource contention.Identify and address performance bottlenecks through query optimization, index tuning, and database configuration adjustments.Optimize database indexes, query execution plans, and caching strategies to improve application responsiveness and scalability.Write and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures to efficiently retrieve and manipulate data.Configure and maintain database replication, clustering, or failover mechanisms to provide resilience against hardware failures, network outages, or natural disasters.Participate in code reviews to ensure adherence to database best practices, performance guidelines, and data access patterns.Collaborate with software developers to design database schemas that align with application requirements and development workflows.Work closely with application developers to optimize SQL queries, data access patterns, and database interactions for maximum efficiency.Perform regular backups and disaster recovery procedures to ensure data availability and integrity.Stay abreast of emerging database technologies, trends, and best practices through self-study, training, and participation in industry forums and conferences.What are we looking for?Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field In-depth knowledge and proficiency in PL\\pgSQL and T-SQLStrong understanding of database design principles, including normalization, indexing, and data modelingKnowledge of database security best practices and experience in implementing security measures such as user authentication, access controls, encryption, and auditing are importantKnowledge of the AWS RDS solutionStrong troubleshooting and problem-solving skillsEffective communication and collaboration skillsCommunicative level of EnglishTech stackPostgreSQLOracleAmazon Web ServicesC# .NetWhat do we offer? 🏢💻Hybrid Framework - The best of both worlds! Work from home when you need focus and flexibility, and spend 2 days a week in the office for face-to-face collaboration, sharing ideas and catching up with the team. Because some things are simply better together!📙 Personal Training Budget. Up to 7.000 year training budget (certifications, conferences attendance, etc.) to invest in your professional development. We want to help you improve your technical skills, feel involved in the product community, and develop your soft skills to lead teams and manage other stakeholders.📺 Internal and external training, free access to online training platforms such as Linkedin Learning🗺️ Languages classes every week. Thirsty for knowledge? Learn a new language by joining our free English/Spanish/German classes. You can connect and enjoy taking up a new language or improving your current skills with one of our great instructors.💜 Lunch card. Enjoy a subsidized lunch card and grab a meal with your teammates — because the best conversations often happen over lunch!🏥 Free private medical insurance. Take care of your health with private medical care fully covered by us📄 Attractive life insurance. Extra peace of mind for you and your loved ones.🏐 Co-financed Multisport card - We support an active lifestyle because staying healthy and feeling good matters.😊 Volunteer day. You can take 16 hours per year in order to participate in volunteering activities! We will love to see some pictures in our slack!🌅 Up to 30 days of vacation per year (additional days are granted along with seniority at AUCTANE).💙 Up to 1000 PLN/year PLN/year to match your NGO donations! We are happy to support your initiatives by duplicating the amount donated.👩‍⚕️We have an Employee Assistance Program with psychological assistance free of charge for you and your loved ones.🗓️ Annual Salary Review: We are reviewing the salaries of all our teams annually in order to evaluate an increase according to individual performance and the business results.Referral Fee 🔗 We need your support in hiring top-class talent! We offer a referral bonus of 4k-20k PLN, depending on the complexity of the role and the hiring process.💜 An inclusive and upbeat work environment Leave your suit behind... we’re a t-shirt and converse kind of place! More importantly, our company culture promotes diversity and inclusion. The personality and opinions of each of our team members are important and valid, and we aim to offer all employees a safe environment where they can be themselves and thrive.🌍 A cross-cultural atmosphere We are a truly international team of 20 nationalities that speak 10 languages. Our company language is English and all internal communication and company-wide meetings are in English.🏟️ Company events We do our best every day, even at our regular team-building events.🏢 Nice Office in Zielona Gora and Wroclaw (free drinks, snacks…)Do you want to know a little bit more about the team? Please, don’t hesitate to reach out to Amazing Auctane-PL and our Instagram

jobposting.description: Sweden, Malmö Metropolitan AreaQA Test Automation Expert (Server side)Test & QA Technology industryStart date: ASAPDuration:  12 months+Language: English/Full professionalSeniority: SeniorIntroduction & SummaryWe are seeking skilled QA Test Automation Experts.  The ideal candidate will excel in combining manual testing with automation techniques, executing detailed functional and user-experience testing while adhering to high standards.Main ResponsibilitiesConduct daily functional and regression testing.Plan, document, and execute comprehensive test cases, test plans, and strategies.Identify, reproduce, and report on detailed bugs and feature-related issues.Analyze test coverage, track progress, and communicate results effectively.Automate manual test cases utilizing Swift-based frameworks such as XCTest and XCUI or other server-side frameworks.Collaborate with development and design teams to guarantee feature quality and user experience.Maintain a meticulous focus on detail and ensure the visual and functional quality of features.Key RequirementsIn addition to the requirement of Swift + XCUITest Automation experience, we're are mainly looking for someone with server-side testing experience.Background in manual QA testing and familiarity with structured testing methodologies.Capable of implementing automation scripts. Swift programming is “nice to have”. Familiar with Unix/shell scripting and Python for enhancing test workflows.Strong emphasis on user experience, functional accuracy, and effective issue triage.Exceptional communication and problem-solving skills.Ability to work independently in dynamic environments.In addition to the requirement of Swift + XCUITest Automation experience, we're also looking for someone with server-side testing experience.Here are the additional qualifications for the server-related aspect:·         Experience with test automation frameworks for API testing & backend services:  including designing, implementing, and maintaining automated test suites·         Ability to validate request/response payloads, headers, authentication, and error handling·         Skilled in analyzing server logs and debugging backend issues with query parameters·         Experience in functional, regression, integration & performance testing·         Ability to work closely with developers and product teams to understand requirements·         Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines·         Familiarity with contract testing for server-side systems·         Knowledge of Docker & microservices architecture (nice to have)·         Security testing knowledge (API security best practices)Other DetailsEducation should include a BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience, and candidates should have approximately 3+ years of experience in QA or software testing within complex software ecosystems.Start date: ASAP.Duration: Long-term project (12 months contract + extension).Location: Malmö (5 days onsite weekly + a number of evening meetings).

jobposting.description: About cerebre cerebre is on a mission to build the data foundation of the physical world. We offer a live intelligence map of a facilities – built from schematics to power AI. Often called the “brain” of the digital twin, cerebre helps engineers, data scientists, and business teams understand data within the context of the plant.  We collaborate with the world’s largest companies and most innovative partners who are transforming the industrial sector.  cerebre is a global team of engineers, scientists, innovators, and explorers united by a mission to help the world’s largest manufacturing facilities build and use intelligence.  Our development team is made up of world-class engineers who design and deliver novel solutions. This is an opportunity to join a market-leading team that is changing how the industrial world works.  If you love building and creating value in the “white space,” if you thrive with the freedom and flexibility to think outside the box, if you are passionate about working with critical thinkers who challenge the status quo, and if you aspire to work in a fast-paced environment – we would love to meet you! We believe flexibility drives creativity and that our team should live and work where we can be our best selves. We’re 100% remote and offer a competitive time-off package to ensure time for rest and recharge. About the role We are looking for a .NET Software Engineer to take our platform to the next level. You will be working on a team focused on building the largest knowledge graph in the industrial world. This role offers the chance to solve never seen technology problems. If you are interested in solving challenging technical problems with freedom to think creatively, this role is for you.  Required Skills  7+ years of professional software development with expert level in .Net  Experience working in Agile (preferably, Kanban) Experience with Azure Cloud and/or AWS Experience with graph databases (e.g., RedisGraph, Neo4j, MemGraph, FalkorDB) Architectural vision for product development Ability to write clean code in accordance with modern programming standards Problem solver mentality with the ability to design unique solutions to unique problems  Desire to learn and continuously improve At least B2 English level Preferred Skills Experience in Gitlab, including CI/CD Data modeling expertise  Experience with NoSQL Database Familiarity with TypeScript, React  More about cerebre We are cross-functional collaborators.  We blend manufacturing process knowledge with software and big data engineering expertise to create value in physical settings We are experienced.  We are armed with industry-leading experts in numerical simulation, combustion, power, computational fluid dynamics, and chemical process modeling We are serious builders.  We develop our platforms using leading practices in IT/OT architecture, OT security, AI architecture, ML Ops, and Platform engineering

jobposting.description: We're looking for a Senior Platform Reliability Engineer who brings strong software engineering skills and a deep understanding of system behavior under load and stress. This role is a good fit for someone who wants to own reliability as a first-class concern – building the foundational systems that protect Asana's platform, not just responding when things go wrong.You'll build core platform systems like load shedding, rate limiting, circuit breakers, and traffic controls that protect Asana under real-world load. This is deep, cross-cutting work that shapes stability and performance of our entire infrastructure – and you'll partner closely with other platform teams to make reliability something that's built in, not bolted on.Our tech stack includes: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), CloudFront, Istio, Cilium,  MySQL (RDS), OpenSearch, DynamoDB, Redis, Terraform, Datadog, TypeScript, Scala, Go, and Python. (Yeah, we know this sounds like buzzword bingo – but we want this post to actually show up in your searches.)Why this role?Reliability as a first-class feature: You won't be patching things up after the fact. You'll build the systems that make Asana resilient by design.Foundational work: Load shedding, traffic management, ingress/egress – these are the building blocks that protect everything else. You'll own them.Strong collaboration, reasonable hours: You'll work closely with infrastructure teams in Warsaw and Reykjavik, making deep collaboration practical without constant timezone gymnastics.Room to grow: This is a new team, and you'll help shape what Platform Reliability Engineering looks like at Asana – whether that means leading projects, mentoring others, or defining our technical direction.In this role, success means shipping systems that other teams rely on by default – because they make the platform safer, not because they're mandatory.We're especially interested in people who think like backend engineers but obsess over failure modes, capacity planning, and building systems that degrade gracefully under pressure.This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. jobposting.description: Model pracy: 2x w miesiącu z biura w ŁodziStawka: zgodnie z oczekiwaniami Współpraca: długofalowa współpraca, B2BWprowadzenie: Poszukiwany jest Architekt Rozwiązań Aplikacji z kilkuletnim doświadczeniem w obszarze architektury rozwiązań, DevOps, Platform Engineering lub Engineering Excellence. Kandydat powinien doskonale znać cykl wytwarzania oprogramowania oraz nowoczesne praktyki inżynieryjne, potrafić analizować procesy i wskazywać obszary wymagające optymalizacji, a także posiadać umiejętności w obszarze CI/CD oraz automatyzacji procesów developerskich.Główne obowiązki:Do podstawowych zadań osoby na tym stanowisku należy: Analiza procesów wytwarzania oprogramowania oraz identyfikowanie obszarów wymagających usprawnień i automatyzacji.Projektowanie i rozwijanie rozwiązań wspierających monitorowanie oraz obserwowalność procesu SDLC.Definiowanie standardów, mierników oraz dobrych praktyk w zakresie efektywnego dostarczania oprogramowania.Współpraca z zespołami developerskimi, DevOps, architektami i liderami technologicznymi przy wdrażaniu usprawnień.Projektowanie i wdrażanie rozwiązań z obszaru CI/CD, automatyzacji testów, jakości kodu oraz observability.Tworzenie i rozwijanie dashboardów oraz raportów prezentujących efektywność procesu wytwórczego.Analiza danych procesowych, identyfikowanie wąskich gardeł oraz rekomendowanie działań zwiększających produktywność zespołów.Ocena nowych narzędzi i technologii wspierających deweloperów oraz rekomendowanie ich wdrożenia.Projektowanie i wdrażanie automatyzacji ograniczających pracę manualną oraz skracających czas dostarczania zmian.Prowadzenie warsztatów, konsultacji i działań edukacyjnych wspierających rozwój praktyk engineering excellence w organizacji.Kluczowe wymagania:Kilkuletnie doświadczenie w obszarze architektury rozwiązań, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Developer Experience lub Engineering Excellence.Znajomość cyklu wytwarzania oprogramowania (SDLC) oraz współczesnych praktyk inżynieryjnych.Umiejętność analizy procesów oraz identyfikacji zależności.Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i wdrażaniu rozwiązań CI/CD.Znajomość narzędzi wspierających jakość kodu (np. SonarQube) oraz automatyzację procesów developerskich.Doświadczenie w pracy z rozwiązaniami observability i monitoringu (np. Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace).Znajomość mierników efektywności procesu wytwórczego, w tym DORA Metrics, Lead Time czy MTTR.Komunikatywność w języku angielskim pozwalająca na pracę z dokumentacją techniczną.Samodzielność oraz inicjatywa w proponowaniu usprawnień.Umiejętność pracy z wymaganiami zgłaszanymi przez zespoły technologiczne.Miło widziane:Doświadczenie w pracy w międzynarodowych zespołach.Znajomość narzędzi CI/CD (np. Jenkins, GitLab).Umiejętność programowania w popularnych językach (np. Python, Java).

data into a target Salesforce ecosystem.This role requires a hands-on contributor who will build, test, and execute data migration strategies while ensuring high-quality, accurate data loads across complex Salesforce CPQ and CLM environments.ResponsibilitiesBuild and execute extraction, transformation, mapping, validation, and loading (ETL/ELT) processes as defined in the data migration strategyContribute to code reviews and adhere to technical standards and validation protocols established for the migration teamExecute rollback and disaster recovery procedures during mock and production cutovers, flag issues, and support rapid resolutionExecute the migration of complex, relational CPQ data, including Product Catalogs, Price Books, Quote templates, Subscriptions, Assets, and multi-tier Contracting hierarchies, while maintaining referential integrityCollaborate with Salesforce Architects and the Technical Lead to map legacy financial and billing data into target Salesforce ARM and CLM data structuresTroubleshoot and resolve data mapping issues unique to CPQ, such as migrating active subscription contracts and aligning historical pricing rulesApply data profiling and cleansing standards to ensure high-fidelity, deduplicated data is loaded into the target environmentFollow data security and compliance requirements to ensure migrated data meets regulatory and enterprise data governance frameworksBuild and run automated validation scripts to perform pre- and post-load reconciliation in support of full financial data accuracyRequirements5+ years of IT experience, including 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce Data Migration experience on enterprise-scale implementationsExperience executing at least one major migration involving Salesforce CPQ/BillingUnderstanding of CPQ data structures, including how Quote Lines, Subscriptions, and Contract objects interrelateProficiency in Salesforce ETL tools such as MuleSoft, Informatica, and Talend or JitterbitSkills in data loading tools such as SF Data Loader, Copado, and Salesforce DXStrong SQL skills and data modeling experienceExperience working with high-volume data sets containing millions of recordsEnglish proficiency at B2 level or higherNice to haveSalesforce Certified CPQ SpecialistSalesforce Certified Data Architect (working towards or held)We offerWe gather like-minded people:Top tech minds driving innovation in AI, cloud and digital platform modernizationSupportive team and an agile, startup-like cultureHybrid by design mode and opportunity to work remotely within PolandChance to work abroad for up to 60 days annuallyBusiness-driven relocation opportunitiesWe provide growth opportunities:Career development programsThought leadership, mentoring, soft skills and well-being programsCertification (Anthropic, Gemini, GCP, Azure, AWS)English classesWe cover it all:Stable payParticipation in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan with a 15% discountBenefits package (health insurance, multisport, shopping vouchers)Referral bonuses up to $2,000Offices featuring entertainment and relaxation zones, table tennis and football, free snacks, coffee and moreCorporate, social and well-being eventsPlease, note:We will reach out to selected candidates exclusivelyEPAM is global leader in AI transformation engineering and integrated consulting, serving Forbes Global 2000 companies and ambitious startups.
